steps.message:
As an operator-planner in an Independent System Operator, you create a base case for tomorrow's peak hour each morning in order to establish the voltage profile and verify that the day-ahead market schedule is AC-feasible. In order to do this, you should use the model described in `math-model.md` to find a least-cost, AC feasible operating point and then produce a report in `report.json`. The report should follow the structure below with all power values in MW or MVAr, angles in degrees, voltages in per-unit.

    "total_generation_MW": 145200.00,
    "total_generation_MVAr": 32000.00,
    "total_losses_MW": 360.94,

  },
  "generators": [

I'll help you create a base case for tomorrow's peak hour as an ISO operator-planner. Let me start by reading the math model to understand the approach.

# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC OPF) Solver
Based on the mathematical model in math-model.md
Minimizes generation cost subject to AC power flow constraints
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix, diags
import cmath

def load_network(filepath):
    """Load network data from JSON file (MATPOWER format)"""
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    return data

def parse_bus_data(bus_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse bus data - format: [id, type, Pd, Qd, Gs, Bs, area, vm, va, baseKV, zone, vmax, vmin]"""
    buses = []
    for row in bus_list:
        bus = {
            'id': int(row[0]),
            'type': int(row[1]),  # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=ref
            'Pd': row[2] / baseMVA,  # Convert to p.u.
            'Qd': row[3] / baseMVA,
            'Gs': row[4] / baseMVA,
            'Bs': row[5] / baseMVA,
            'vm': row[7],
            'va': row[8],
            'vmax': row[11],
            'vmin': row[12]
        }
        buses.append(bus)
    return buses

def parse_gen_data(gen_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse generator data - format: [bus, Pg, Qg, Qmax, Qmin, Vg, mBase, status, Pmax, Pmin, Pc1, Pc2]"""
    generators = []
    for i, row in enumerate(gen_list):
        gen = {
            'id': i + 1,
            'bus': int(row[0]),
            'Pg': row[1] / baseMVA,
            'Qg': row[2] / baseMVA,
            'Qmax': row[3] / baseMVA,
            'Qmin': row[4] / baseMVA,
            'Vg': row[5],
            'Pmax': row[8] / baseMVA,
            'Pmin': row[9] / baseMVA
        }
        generators.append(gen)
    return generators

def parse_gencost_data(gencost_list):
    """Parse generator cost data - format: [model, startup, shutdown, n, c(n-1), ..., c0]"""
    costs = []
    for row in gencost_list:
        model = int(row[0])
        n = int(row[3])
        if model == 2:  # Polynomial
            # Cost coefficients: c2, c1, c0 (or fewer if n < 3)
            c = [float(row[4 + i]) for i in range(n)]
            costs.append({'model': model, 'n': n, 'c': c})
        else:
            costs.append({'model': model, 'n': n, 'c': []})
    return costs

def parse_branch_data(branch_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse branch data - format: [from, to, r, x, b, rateA, rateB, rateC, ratio, angle, status, angmin, angmax]"""
    branches = []
    for i, row in enumerate(branch_list):
        branch = {
            'id': i + 1,
            'from_bus': int(row[0]),
            'to_bus': int(row[1]),
            'r': row[2],
            'x': row[3],
            'b': row[4],
            'rateA': row[5] / baseMVA,  # MVA limit in p.u.
            'rateB': row[6] / baseMVA,
            'rateC': row[7] / baseMVA,
            'ratio': row[8],  # Transformer tap ratio
            'angle': row[9] * np.pi / 180,  # Convert to radians
            'angmin': row[11] * np.pi / 180,
            'angmax': row[12] * np.pi / 180
        }
        branches.append(branch)
    return branches

def build_ybus(buses, branches):
    """Build bus admittance matrix"""
    n_buses = len(buses)
    ybus = np.zeros((n_buses, n_buses), dtype=complex)

    # Create bus index mapping
    bus_ids = {bus['id']: i for i, bus in enumerate(buses)}

    for branch in branches:
        f = bus_ids[branch['from_bus']]
        t = bus_ids[branch['to_bus']]

        r = branch['r']
        x = branch['x']
        z = r + 1j * x
        y = 1.0 / z

        tap = branch['ratio'] * np.exp(1j * branch['angle'])

        # Series admittance
        y_series = y

        # Shunt admittance
        b = branch['b']
        y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

        # Off-nominal tap
        if tap != 1.0:
            ybus[f, f] += y_series / (tap * np.conj(tap)) + y_shunt
            ybus[t, t] += y_series
            ybus[f, t] -= y_series / np.conj(tap)
            ybus[t, f] -= y_series / tap
        else:
            ybus[f, f] += y_series + y_shunt
            ybus[t, t] += y_series + y_shunt
            ybus[f, t] -= y_series
            ybus[t, f] -= y_series

    return ybus

def power_flow_equations(x, buses, generators, gencosts, ybus, baseMVA):
    """
    Compute power balance mismatches
    x = [Vm_1, ..., Vm_n, Va_1, ..., Va_n, Pg_1, ..., Pg_ng, Qg_1, ..., Qg_ng]
    """
    n_buses = len(buses)
    n_gens = len(generators)

    # Extract voltages
    Vm = x[:n_buses]
    Va = x[n_buses:2*n_buses]
    Pg = x[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
    Qg = x[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

    # Build voltage vector
    V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)

    # Compute complex power injection
    S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

    # Compute load
    S_load = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        S_load[i] = bus['Pd'] + 1j * bus['Qd']

    # Compute generator injection
    S_gen = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
        S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

    # Power mismatch (excluding reference bus)
    P_mismatch = []
    Q_mismatch = []
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        P_calc = S_inj[i].real + S_load[i].real - S_gen[i].real
        Q_calc = S_inj[i].imag + S_load[i].imag - S_gen[i].imag

        if bus['type'] == 3:  # Reference bus - don't include Q mismatch
            P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
        elif bus['type'] == 2:  # PV bus - don't include Q mismatch
            P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
        else:  # PQ bus
            P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
            Q_mismatch.append(Q_calc)

    return np.array(P_mismatch + Q_mismatch)

def cost_function(x, generators, gencosts):
    """Compute total generation cost"""
    n_buses = len(x) // 2  # Approximation
    n_gens = len(generators)

    Pg = x[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]

    total_cost = 0.0
    for k, (gen, cost) in enumerate(zip(generators, gencosts)):
        Pgpu = Pg[k]
        PgMW = Pgpu * 100.0  # Convert back to MW for cost calc

        # Polynomial cost: c2*Pg^2 + c1*Pg + c0
        if cost['n'] >= 3:
            total_cost += cost['c'][0] * PgMW**2 + cost['c'][1] * PgMW + cost['c'][2]
        elif cost['n'] == 2:
            total_cost += cost['c'][0] * PgMW + cost['c'][1]
        elif cost['n'] == 1:
            total_cost += cost['c'][0]

    return total_cost

def solve_acopf(buses, generators, gencosts, branches, ybus, baseMVA):
    """
    Solve AC Optimal Power Flow using sequential quadratic programming
    """
    n_buses = len(buses)
    n_gens = len(generators)

    # Identify reference bus
    ref_bus_idx = next(i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 3)

    # Initial guess
    Vm_init = np.array([bus['vm'] for bus in buses])
    Va_init = np.array([bus['va'] * np.pi / 180 for bus in buses])
    Pg_init = np.array([gen['Pg'] for gen in generators])
    Qg_init = np.array([gen['Qg'] for gen in generators])

    # Set reference bus angle to 0
    Va_init[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

    # Initial state vector (excluding reference bus angles and Q at PV buses)
    # We'll handle constraints differently

    x0 = np.concatenate([Vm_init, Va_init, Pg_init, Qg_init])

    # Create masks for variable indices
    Va_mask = np.ones(n_buses, dtype=bool)
    Va_mask[ref_bus_idx] = False

    PV_buses = [i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 2]
    PQ_buses = [i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 1]

    # Function to extract variables and compute mismatches
    def mismatch_and_cost(state):
        Vm = state[:n_buses]
        Va = state[n_buses:2*n_buses]
        Pg = state[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
        Qg = state[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

        # Ensure reference angle is 0
        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
        S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

        # Load
        Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
        Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])

        # Generator injection at buses
        S_gen = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
        for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
            bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
            S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

        # Power balance
        P_balance = np.real(S_inj) + Pd - np.real(S_gen)
        Q_balance = np.imag(S_inj) + Qd - np.imag(S_gen)

        # Mismatches for PQ and PV buses (P) and PQ buses (Q)
        mismatch = []

        # P mismatch for all buses except reference
        for i in range(n_buses):
            if i != ref_bus_idx:
                mismatch.append(P_balance[i])

        # Q mismatch for PQ buses only
        for i in PQ_buses:
            mismatch.append(Q_balance[i])

        mismatch = np.array(mismatch)

        # Cost
        cost = 0.0
        for k, cost_data in enumerate(gencosts):
            PgMW = Pg[k] * baseMVA
            if cost_data['n'] >= 3:
                c = cost_data['c']
                cost += c[0] * PgMW**2 + c[1] * PgMW + c[2]
            elif cost_data['n'] == 2:
                c = cost_data['c']
                cost += c[0] * PgMW + c[1]

        return mismatch, cost, S_inj, S_gen, Vm, Va

    # Use Newton-Raphson power flow as starting point, then optimize
    # For simplicity, we'll use the initial power flow solution and adjust dispatch

    def objective_and_constraints(state):
        Vm = state[:n_buses]
        Va = state[n_buses:2*n_buses]
        Pg = state[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
        Qg = state[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0
        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
        S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

        Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
        Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])

        S_gen = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
        for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
            bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
            S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

        # Power balance constraints
        constraints = []

        # P balance for non-reference buses
        for i in range(n_buses):
            if i != ref_bus_idx:
                constraints.append({
                    'type': 'eq',
                    'fun': lambda s, idx=i: np.real(S_inj[idx]) + Pd[idx] - np.real(S_gen[idx])
                })

        # Q balance for PQ buses
        for i in PQ_buses:
            constraints.append({
                'type': 'eq',
                'fun': lambda s, idx=i: np.imag(S_inj[idx]) + Qd[idx] - np.imag(S_gen[idx])
            })

        # Cost
        cost = 0.0
        for k, cost_data in enumerate(gencosts):
            PgMW = Pg[k] * baseMVA
            if cost_data['n'] >= 3:
                c = cost_data['c']
                cost += c[0] * PgMW**2 + c[1] * PgMW + c[2]
            elif cost_data['n'] == 2:
                c = cost_data['c']
                cost += c[0] * PgMW + c[1]

        return cost, constraints

    # Simplified approach: Run power flow first, then economic dispatch
    # For this implementation, we'll use a more practical approach

    # Use scipy's minimize with constraints
    def objective(state):
        Vm = state[:n_buses]
        Va = state[n_buses:2*n_buses]
        Pg = state[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
        Qg = state[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

        cost = 0.0
        for k, cost_data in enumerate(gencosts):
            PgMW = Pg[k] * baseMVA
            if cost_data['n'] >= 3:
                c = cost_data['c']
                cost += c[0] * PgMW**2 + c[1] * PgMW + c[2]
            elif cost_data['n'] == 2:
                c = cost_data['c']
                cost += c[0] * PgMW + c[1]

        return cost

    def eq_constraints(state):
        Vm = state[:n_buses]
        Va = state[n_buses:2*n_buses]
        Pg = state[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
        Qg = state[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0
        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
        S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

        Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
        Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])

        S_gen = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
        for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
            bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
            S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

        cons = []

        # P balance for non-reference buses
        for i in range(n_buses):
            if i != ref_bus_idx:
                cons.append(np.real(S_inj[i]) + Pd[i] - np.real(S_gen[i]))

        # Q balance for PQ buses
        for i in PQ_buses:
            cons.append(np.imag(S_inj[i]) + Qd[i] - np.imag(S_gen[i]))

        return np.array(cons)

    # Bounds
    bounds = []

    # Vm bounds
    for bus in buses:
        bounds.append((bus['vmin'], bus['vmax']))

    # Va bounds (exclude reference)
    for i in range(n_buses):
        if i == ref_bus_idx:
            bounds.append((0.0, 0.0))  # Reference angle fixed
        else:
            bounds.append((-np.pi, np.pi))

    # Pg bounds
    for gen in generators:
        bounds.append((gen['Pmin'], gen['Pmax']))

    # Qg bounds
    for gen in generators:
        bounds.append((gen['Qmin'], gen['Qmax']))

    # Constraint definitions for SLSQP
    cons = []

    # P balance constraints
    for i in range(n_buses):
        if i != ref_bus_idx:
            cons.append({'type': 'eq', 'fun': lambda s, idx=i: eq_constraints(s)[idx])

    # Q balance constraints
    for i, pq_idx in enumerate(PQ_buses):
        offset = n_buses - 1  # Number of P constraints
        cons.append({'type': 'eq', 'fun': lambda s, off=offset, pq=pq_idx: eq_constraints(s)[off + i]})

    try:
        result = minimize(
            objective,
            x0,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=bounds,
            constraints=cons,
            options={'ftol': 1e-9, 'maxiter': 1000, 'disp': False}
        )

        status = 'optimal' if result.success else 'infeasible'

        # Extract solution
        Vm = result.x[:n_buses]
        Va = result.x[n_buses:2*n_buses]
        Pg = result.x[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
        Qg = result.x[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Optimization failed: {e}")
        status = 'infeasible'
        Vm, Va, Pg, Qg = Vm_init, Va_init, Pg_init, Qg_init

    return {
        'Vm': Vm,
        'Va': Va,
        'Pg': Pg,
        'Qg': Qg,
        'status': status,
        'x_opt': result.x if 'result' in dir() else x0
    }

def compute_power_flow_solution(buses, generators, ybus, baseMVA, Vm_init, Va_init):
    """Run power flow to get consistent solution"""
    n_buses = len(buses)

    ref_bus_idx = next(i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 3)

    def power_mismatch(state):
        Vm = state[:n_buses]
        Va = state[n_buses:]
        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
        S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

        Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
        Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])

        # P mismatch for all buses except reference
        P_mismatch = []
        Q_mismatch = []

        for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
            P_calc = np.real(S_inj[i]) + Pd[i]
            Q_calc = np.imag(S_inj[i]) + Qd[i]

            if i == ref_bus_idx:
                P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
            else:
                P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
                Q_mismatch.append(Q_calc)

        return np.array(P_mismatch + Q_mismatch)

    # Newton-Raphson power flow
    state = np.concatenate([Vm_init, Va_init])

    for _ in range(100):
        mismatch = power_mismatch(state)
        if np.max(np.abs(mismatch)) < 1e-8:
            break

        # Jacobian
        # Simplified - using numerical derivatives
        eps = 1e-8
        J = np.zeros((2*n_buses - 1, 2*n_buses))

        for j in range(2*n_buses):
            state_plus = state.copy()
            state_plus[j] += eps
            mismatch_plus = power_mismatch(state_plus)
            J[:, j] = (mismatch_plus - mismatch) / eps

        # Solve for update
        try:
            delta = np.linalg.lstsq(J, -mismatch, rcond=None)[0]
            state += delta
        except:
            break

    return state

def compute_branch_flows(buses, branches, ybus, Vm, Va, baseMVA):
    """Compute branch power flows"""
    n_buses = len(buses)
    bus_ids = {bus['id']: i for i, bus in enumerate(buses)}

    branch_flows = []

    for branch in branches:
        f = bus_ids[branch['from_bus']]
        t = bus_ids[branch['to_bus']]

        Vf = Vm[f] * np.exp(1j * Va[f])
        Vt = Vm[t] * np.exp(1j * Va[t])

        # Series admittance
        z = branch['r'] + 1j * branch['x']
        y = 1.0 / z

        tap = branch['ratio'] * np.exp(1j * branch['angle'])

        if tap != 1.0:
            # Transformer
            S_from = (y * np.abs(Vf)**2 / np.abs(tap)**2 - y * Vf * np.conj(Vt) / np.conj(tap)) * baseMVA
            S_to = (y * np.abs(Vt)**2 - y * Vt * np.conj(Vf) / tap) * baseMVA
        else:
            S_from = (y * np.abs(Vf)**2 - y * Vf * np.conj(Vt)) * baseMVA
            S_to = (y * np.abs(Vt)**2 - y * Vt * np.conj(Vf)) * baseMVA

        loading = np.abs(S_from) / branch['rateA'] * 100 if branch['rateA'] > 0 else 0

        branch_flows.append({
            'from_bus': branch['from_bus'],
            'to_bus': branch['to_bus'],
            'flow_from_MVA': np.abs(S_from),
            'flow_to_MVA': np.abs(S_to),
            'loading_pct': loading,
            'limit_MVA': branch['rateA'] * baseMVA
        })

    return branch_flows

def main():
    # Load network data
    data = load_network('/root/network.json')

    baseMVA = data['baseMVA']

    # Parse data
    buses = parse_bus_data(data['bus'], baseMVA)
    generators = parse_gen_data(data['gen'], baseMVA)
    gencosts = parse_gencost_data(data['gencost'])
    branches = parse_branch_data(data['branch'], baseMVA)

    print(f"Network: {data['name']}")
    print(f"Base MVA: {baseMVA}")
    print(f"Buses: {len(buses)}, Generators: {len(generators)}, Branches: {len(branches)}")

    # Build Ybus
    ybus = build_ybus(buses, branches)

    # Solve AC OPF
    print("\nSolving AC Optimal Power Flow...")
    solution = solve_acopf(buses, generators, gencosts, branches, ybus, baseMVA)

    Vm = solution['Vm']
    Va = solution['Va'] * 180 / np.pi  # Convert to degrees
    Pg = solution['Pg'] * baseMVA  # Convert to MW
    Qg = solution['Qg'] * baseMVA  # Convert to MVAr

    # Compute branch flows
    branch_flows = compute_branch_flows(buses, branches, ybus, Vm, solution['Va'], baseMVA)

    # Compute totals
    total_Pg = np.sum(Pg)
    total_Qg = np.sum(Qg)
    total_Pd = sum(bus['Pd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses)
    total_Qd = sum(bus['Qd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses)
    total_losses = total_Pg - total_Pd

    # Compute cost
    total_cost = 0.0
    for k, cost in enumerate(gencosts):
        PgMW = Pg[k]
        if cost['n'] >= 3:
            c = cost['c']
            total_cost += c[0] * PgMW**2 + c[1] * PgMW + c[2]
        elif cost['n'] == 2:
            c = cost['c']
            total_cost += c[0] * PgMW + c[1]

    # Verify feasibility
    # Compute power mismatches
    V = Vm * np.exp(1j * solution['Va'] * np.pi / 180)
    S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

    Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses])
    Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses])

    # Generator injection at buses
    S_gen = np.zeros(len(buses), dtype=complex)
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
        S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

    P_mismatch = np.real(S_inj) + Pd - np.real(S_gen)
    Q_mismatch = np.imag(S_inj) + Qd - np.imag(S_gen)

    max_P_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(P_mismatch))
    max_Q_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(Q_mismatch))

    # Voltage violations
    v_violations = []
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        if Vm[i] < bus['vmin'] or Vm[i] > bus['vmax']:
            v_violations.append(abs(Vm[i] - bus['vmin']) if Vm[i] < bus['vmin'] else abs(Vm[i] - bus['vmax']))
    max_v_violation = max(v_violations) if v_violations else 0.0

    # Branch overloads
    overloads = []
    for bf in branch_flows:
        if bf['flow_from_MVA'] > bf['limit_MVA']:
            overloads.append(bf['flow_from_MVA'] - bf['limit_MVA'])
    max_overload = max(overloads) if overloads else 0.0

    # Build report
    report = {
        "summary": {
            "total_cost_per_hour": round(total_cost, 2),
            "total_load_MW": round(total_Pd, 2),
            "total_load_MVAr": round(total_Qd, 2),
            "total_generation_MW": round(total_Pg, 2),
            "total_generation_MVAr": round(total_Qg, 2),
            "total_losses_MW": round(total_losses, 2),
            "solver_status": solution['status']
        },
        "generators": [],
        "buses": [],
        "most_loaded_branches": [],
        "feasibility_check": {
            "max_p_mismatch_MW": round(max_P_mismatch, 6),
            "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": round(max_Q_mismatch, 6),
            "max_voltage_violation_pu": round(max_v_violation, 6),
            "max_branch_overload_MVA": round(max_overload, 6)
        }
    }

    # Add generators
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        report["generators"].append({
            "id": gen['id'],
            "bus": gen['bus'],
            "pg_MW": round(Pg[k], 4),
            "qg_MVAr": round(Qg[k], 4),
            "pmin_MW": round(gen['Pmin'] * baseMVA, 4),
            "pmax_MW": round(gen['Pmax'] * baseMVA, 4),
            "qmin_MVAr": round(gen['Qmin'] * baseMVA, 4),
            "qmax_MVAr": round(gen['Qmax'] * baseMVA, 4)
        })

    # Add buses
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        report["buses"].append({
            "id": bus['id'],
            "vm_pu": round(Vm[i], 6),
            "va_deg": round(Va[i], 4),
            "vmin_pu": bus['vmin'],
            "vmax_pu": bus['vmax']
        })

    # Sort branches by loading and add top 10 most loaded

            "max_branch_overload_MVA": round(max_overload, 6)
        }
    }

    # Add generators
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        report["generators"].append({
            "id": gen['id'],
            "bus": gen['bus'],
            "pg_MW": round(Pg[k], 4),
            "qg_MVAr": round(Qg[k], 4),
            "pmin_MW": round(gen['Pmin'] * baseMVA, 4),
            "pmax_MW": round(gen['Pmax'] * baseMVA, 4),
            "qmin_MVAr": round(gen['Qmin'] * baseMVA, 4),
            "qmax_MVAr": round(gen['Qmax'] * baseMVA, 4)
        })

    # Add buses
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):

            "limit_MVA": round(bf['limit_MVA'], 4)
        })

    # Write report

    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("AC OPF SOLUTION COMPLETE")
    print("="*60)

    print(f"Total Generation: {total_Pg:.2f} MW, {total_Qg:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"Total Load: {total_Pd:.2f} MW, {total_Qd:.2f} MVAr")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC OPF) Solver
Based on the mathematical model in math-model.md
Minimizes generation cost subject to AC power flow constraints
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix, diags
import cmath

def load_network(filepath):
    """Load network data from JSON file (MATPOWER format)"""
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    return data

def parse_bus_data(bus_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse bus data - format: [id, type, Pd, Qd, Gs, Bs, area, vm, va, baseKV, zone, vmax, vmin]"""
    buses = []
    for row in bus_list:
        bus = {
            'id': int(row[0]),
            'type': int(row[1]),  # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=ref
            'Pd': row[2] / baseMVA,  # Convert to p.u.
            'Qd': row[3] / baseMVA,
            'Gs': row[4] / baseMVA,
            'Bs': row[5] / baseMVA,
            'vm': row[7],
            'va': row[8],
            'vmax': row[11],
            'vmin': row[12]
        }
        buses.append(bus)
    return buses

def parse_gen_data(gen_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse generator data - format: [bus, Pg, Qg, Qmax, Qmin, Vg, mBase, status, Pmax, Pmin, Pc1, Pc2]"""
    generators = []
    for i, row in enumerate(gen_list):
        gen = {
            'id': i + 1,
            'bus': int(row[0]),
            'Pg': row[1] / baseMVA,
            'Qg': row[2] / baseMVA,
            'Qmax': row[3] / baseMVA,
            'Qmin': row[4] / baseMVA,
            'Vg': row[5],
            'Pmax': row[8] / baseMVA,
            'Pmin': row[9] / baseMVA
        }
        generators.append(gen)
    return generators

def parse_gencost_data(gencost_list):
    """Parse generator cost data - format: [model, startup, shutdown, n, c(n-1), ..., c0]"""
    costs = []
    for row in gencost_list:
        model = int(row[0])
        n = int(row[3])
        if model == 2:  # Polynomial
            # Cost coefficients: c2, c1, c0 (or fewer if n < 3)
            c = [float(row[4 + i]) for i in range(n)]
            costs.append({'model': model, 'n': n, 'c': c})
        else:
            costs.append({'model': model, 'n': n, 'c': []})
    return costs

def parse_branch_data(branch_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse branch data - format: [from, to, r, x, b, rateA, rateB, rateC, ratio, angle, status, angmin, angmax]"""
    branches = []
    for i, row in enumerate(branch_list):
        branch = {
            'id': i + 1,
            'from_bus': int(row[0]),
            'to_bus': int(row[1]),
            'r': row[2],
            'x': row[3],
            'b': row[4],
            'rateA': row[5] / baseMVA,  # MVA limit in p.u.
            'rateB': row[6] / baseMVA,
            'rateC': row[7] / baseMVA,
            'ratio': row[8],  # Transformer tap ratio
            'angle': row[9] * np.pi / 180,  # Convert to radians
            'angmin': row[11] * np.pi / 180,
            'angmax': row[12] * np.pi / 180
        }
        branches.append(branch)
    return branches

def build_ybus(buses, branches):
    """Build bus admittance matrix"""
    n_buses = len(buses)
    ybus = np.zeros((n_buses, n_buses), dtype=complex)

    # Create bus index mapping
    bus_ids = {bus['id']: i for i, bus in enumerate(buses)}

    for branch in branches:
        f = bus_ids[branch['from_bus']]
        t = bus_ids[branch['to_bus']]

        r = branch['r']
        x = branch['x']
        z = r + 1j * x
        y = 1.0 / z

        tap = branch['ratio'] * np.exp(1j * branch['angle'])

        # Series admittance
        y_series = y

        # Shunt admittance
        b = branch['b']
        y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

        # Off-nominal tap
        if tap != 1.0:
            ybus[f, f] += y_series / (tap * np.conj(tap)) + y_shunt
            ybus[t, t] += y_series
            ybus[f, t] -= y_series / np.conj(tap)
            ybus[t, f] -= y_series / tap
        else:
            ybus[f, f] += y_series + y_shunt
            ybus[t, t] += y_series + y_shunt
            ybus[f, t] -= y_series
            ybus[t, f] -= y_series

    return ybus

def power_flow_equations(x, buses, generators, gencosts, ybus, baseMVA):
    """
    Compute power balance mismatches
    x = [Vm_1, ..., Vm_n, Va_1, ..., Va_n, Pg_1, ..., Pg_ng, Qg_1, ..., Qg_ng]
    """
    n_buses = len(buses)
    n_gens = len(generators)

    # Extract voltages
    Vm = x[:n_buses]
    Va = x[n_buses:2*n_buses]
    Pg = x[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
    Qg = x[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

    # Build voltage vector
    V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)

    # Compute complex power injection
    S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

    # Compute load
    S_load = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        S_load[i] = bus['Pd'] + 1j * bus['Qd']

    # Compute generator injection
    S_gen = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
        S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

    # Power mismatch (excluding reference bus)
    P_mismatch = []
    Q_mismatch = []
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        P_calc = S_inj[i].real + S_load[i].real - S_gen[i].real
        Q_calc = S_inj[i].imag + S_load[i].imag - S_gen[i].imag

        if bus['type'] == 3:  # Reference bus - don't include Q mismatch
            P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
        elif bus['type'] == 2:  # PV bus - don't include Q mismatch
            P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
        else:  # PQ bus
            P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
            Q_mismatch.append(Q_calc)

    return np.array(P_mismatch + Q_mismatch)

def cost_function(x, generators, gencosts):
    """Compute total generation cost"""
    n_buses = len(x) // 2  # Approximation
    n_gens = len(generators)

    Pg = x[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]

    total_cost = 0.0
    for k, (gen, cost) in enumerate(zip(generators, gencosts)):
        Pgpu = Pg[k]
        PgMW = Pgpu * 100.0  # Convert back to MW for cost calc

        # Polynomial cost: c2*Pg^2 + c1*Pg + c0
        if cost['n'] >= 3:
            total_cost += cost['c'][0] * PgMW**2 + cost['c'][1] * PgMW + cost['c'][2]
        elif cost['n'] == 2:
            total_cost += cost['c'][0] * PgMW + cost['c'][1]
        elif cost['n'] == 1:
            total_cost += cost['c'][0]

    return total_cost

def solve_acopf(buses, generators, gencosts, branches, ybus, baseMVA):
    """

    """
    n_buses = len(buses)

    # Create masks for variable indices
    Va_mask = np.ones(n_buses, dtype=bool)
    Va_mask[ref_bus_idx] = False

    PV_buses = [i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 2]
    PQ_buses = [i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 1]

    # Function to extract variables and compute mismatches
    def mismatch_and_cost(state):
        Vm = state[:n_buses]
        Va = state[n_buses:2*n_buses]

            S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

        # Power balance

            elif cost_data['n'] == 2:

    # For simplicity, we'll use the initial power flow solution and adjust dispatch

    def objective_and_constraints(state):

        # Power balance constraints

        # P balance for non-reference buses

        return cost, constraints

    # Simplified approach: Run power flow first, then economic dispatch
    # For this implementation, we'll use a more practical approach

    # Use scipy's minimize with constraints
    def objective(state):

            elif cost_data['n'] == 2:

                cost += c[0] * PgMW + c[1]

    def eq_constraints(state):

        Va = state[n_buses:2*n_buses]

        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)

        Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])

        for k, gen in enumerate(generators):

        Vm, Va, Pg, Qg = Vm_init, Va_init, Pg_init, Qg_init

    return {

        'Va': Va,
        'Pg': Pg,

def compute_power_flow_solution(buses, generators, ybus, baseMVA, Vm_init, Va_init):
    """Run power flow to get consistent solution"""
    n_buses = len(buses)

    ref_bus_idx = next(i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 3)

    def power_mismatch(state):
        Vm = state[:n_buses]
        Va = state[n_buses:]
        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
        S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

        Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
        Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])

        P_mismatch = []
        Q_mismatch = []

        for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
            P_calc = np.real(S_inj[i]) + Pd[i]
            Q_calc = np.imag(S_inj[i]) + Qd[i]

            if i == ref_bus_idx:
                P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
            else:
                P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
                Q_mismatch.append(Q_calc)

        return np.array(P_mismatch + Q_mismatch)

    # Newton-Raphson power flow
    state = np.concatenate([Vm_init, Va_init])

    for _ in range(100):
        mismatch = power_mismatch(state)
        if np.max(np.abs(mismatch)) < 1e-8:
            break

        # Jacobian
        # Simplified - using numerical derivatives
        eps = 1e-8
        J = np.zeros((2*n_buses - 1, 2*n_buses))

        for j in range(2*n_buses):

            state_plus[j] += eps
            mismatch_plus = power_mismatch(state_plus)
            J[:, j] = (mismatch_plus - mismatch) / eps

        # Solve for update
        try:
            delta = np.linalg.lstsq(J, -mismatch, rcond=None)[0]
            state += delta
        except:

    return state

def compute_branch_flows(buses, branches, ybus, Vm, Va, baseMVA):
    """Compute branch power flows"""
    n_buses = len(buses)
    bus_ids = {bus['id']: i for i, bus in enumerate(buses)}

        z = branch['r'] + 1j * branch['x']
        y = 1.0 / z

        if tap != 1.0:
            # Transformer
            S_from = (y * np.abs(Vf)**2 / np.abs(tap)**2 - y * Vf * np.conj(Vt) / np.conj(tap)) * baseMVA
            S_to = (y * np.abs(Vt)**2 - y * Vt * np.conj(Vf) / tap) * baseMVA
        else:
            S_from = (y * np.abs(Vf)**2 - y * Vf * np.conj(Vt)) * baseMVA
            S_to = (y * np.abs(Vt)**2 - y * Vt * np.conj(Vf)) * baseMVA

        loading = np.abs(S_from) / branch['rateA'] * 100 if branch['rateA'] > 0 else 0

        branch_flows.append({
            'from_bus': branch['from_bus'],
            'to_bus': branch['to_bus'],
            'flow_from_MVA': np.abs(S_from),
            'flow_to_MVA': np.abs(S_to),
            'loading_pct': loading,
            'limit_MVA': branch['rateA'] * baseMVA
        })

    return branch_flows

def main():
    # Load network data
    data = load_network('/root/network.json')

    baseMVA = data['baseMVA']

    # Parse data
    buses = parse_bus_data(data['bus'], baseMVA)
    generators = parse_gen_data(data['gen'], baseMVA)
    gencosts = parse_gencost_data(data['gencost'])
    branches = parse_branch_data(data['branch'], baseMVA)

    print(f"Network: {data['name']}")
    print(f"Base MVA: {baseMVA}")
    print(f"Buses: {len(buses)}, Generators: {len(generators)}, Branches: {len(branches)}")

    # Build Ybus
    ybus = build_ybus(buses, branches)

    # Solve AC OPF
    print("\nSolving AC Optimal Power Flow...")
    solution = solve_acopf(buses, generators, gencosts, branches, ybus, baseMVA)

    Vm = solution['Vm']
    Va = solution['Va'] * 180 / np.pi  # Convert to degrees
    Pg = solution['Pg'] * baseMVA  # Convert to MW
    Qg = solution['Qg'] * baseMVA  # Convert to MVAr

    # Compute branch flows
    branch_flows = compute_branch_flows(buses, branches, ybus, Vm, solution['Va'], baseMVA)

    # Compute totals
    total_Pg = np.sum(Pg)
    total_Qg = np.sum(Qg)
    total_Pd = sum(bus['Pd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses)
    total_Qd = sum(bus['Qd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses)
    total_losses = total_Pg - total_Pd

    # Compute cost
    total_cost = 0.0
    for k, cost in enumerate(gencosts):
        PgMW = Pg[k]
        if cost['n'] >= 3:
            c = cost['c']
            total_cost += c[0] * PgMW**2 + c[1] * PgMW + c[2]
        elif cost['n'] == 2:
            c = cost['c']
            total_cost += c[0] * PgMW + c[1]

    # Verify feasibility
    # Compute power mismatches
    V = Vm * np.exp(1j * solution['Va'] * np.pi / 180)
    S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

    Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses])
    Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses])

    # Generator injection at buses
    S_gen = np.zeros(len(buses), dtype=complex)
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
        S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

    P_mismatch = np.real(S_inj) + Pd - np.real(S_gen)
    Q_mismatch = np.imag(S_inj) + Qd - np.imag(S_gen)

    max_P_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(P_mismatch))
    max_Q_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(Q_mismatch))

    # Voltage violations
    v_violations = []
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        if Vm[i] < bus['vmin'] or Vm[i] > bus['vmax']:
            v_violations.append(abs(Vm[i] - bus['vmin']) if Vm[i] < bus['vmin'] else abs(Vm[i] - bus['vmax']))
    max_v_violation = max(v_violations) if v_violations else 0.0

    # Branch overloads
    overloads = []
    for bf in branch_flows:
        if bf['flow_from_MVA'] > bf['limit_MVA']:
            overloads.append(bf['flow_from_MVA'] - bf['limit_MVA'])
    max_overload = max(overloads) if overloads else 0.0

    # Build report
    report = {
        "summary": {
            "total_cost_per_hour": round(total_cost, 2),
            "total_load_MW": round(total_Pd, 2),
            "total_load_MVAr": round(total_Qd, 2),
            "total_generation_MW": round(total_Pg, 2),
            "total_generation_MVAr": round(total_Qg, 2),
            "total_losses_MW": round(total_losses, 2),
            "solver_status": solution['status']
        },
        "generators": [],
        "buses": [],
        "most_loaded_branches": [],
        "feasibility_check": {
            "max_p_mismatch_MW": round(max_P_mismatch, 6),
            "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": round(max_Q_mismatch, 6),
            "max_voltage_violation_pu": round(max_v_violation, 6),
            "max_branch_overload_MVA": round(max_overload, 6)
        }
    }

    # Add generators
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        report["generators"].append({
            "id": gen['id'],
            "bus": gen['bus'],
            "pg_MW": round(Pg[k], 4),
            "qg_MVAr": round(Qg[k], 4),
            "pmin_MW": round(gen['Pmin'] * baseMVA, 4),
            "pmax_MW": round(gen['Pmax'] * baseMVA, 4),
            "qmin_MVAr": round(gen['Qmin'] * baseMVA, 4),
            "qmax_MVAr": round(gen['Qmax'] * baseMVA, 4)
        })

    # Add buses
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        report["buses"].append({
            "id": bus['id'],
            "vm_pu": round(Vm[i], 6),
            "va_deg": round(Va[i], 4),
            "vmin_pu": bus['vmin'],
            "vmax_pu": bus['vmax']
        })

    # Sort branches by loading and add top 10 most loaded
    sorted_branches = sorted(branch_flows, key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)[:10]
    for bf in sorted_branches:
        report["most_loaded_branches"].append({
            "from_bus": int(bf['from_bus']),
            "to_bus": int(bf['to_bus']),
            "loading_pct": round(bf['loading_pct'], 2),
            "flow_from_MVA": round(bf['flow_from_MVA'], 4),
            "flow_to_MVA": round(bf['flow_to_MVA'], 4),
            "limit_MVA": round(bf['limit_MVA'], 4)
        })

    # Write report
    with open('/root/report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("AC OPF SOLUTION COMPLETE")
    print("="*60)
    print(f"Total Cost: ${total_cost:,.2f}/hr")
    print(f"Total Generation: {total_Pg:.2f} MW, {total_Qg:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"Total Load: {total_Pd:.2f} MW, {total_Qd:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"Total Losses: {total_losses:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Solver Status: {solution['status']}")
    print(f"\nFeasibility:")
    print(f"  Max P mismatch: {max_P_mismatch:.6f} MW")
    print(f"  Max Q mismatch: {max_Q_mismatch:.6f} MVAr")
    print(f"  Max voltage violation: {max_v_violation:.6f} pu")
    print(f"  Max branch overload: {max_overload:.6f} MVA")
    print(f"\nReport saved to /root/report.json")

    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC OPF) Solver
Based on the mathematical model in math-model.md
Minimizes generation cost subject to AC power flow constraints
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix, diags
import cmath

def load_network(filepath):
    """Load network data from JSON file (MATPOWER format)"""
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    return data

def parse_bus_data(bus_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse bus data - format: [id, type, Pd, Qd, Gs, Bs, area, vm, va, baseKV, zone, vmax, vmin]"""
    buses = []
    for row in bus_list:
        bus = {
            'id': int(row[0]),
            'type': int(row[1]),  # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=ref
            'Pd': row[2] / baseMVA,  # Convert to p.u.
            'Qd': row[3] / baseMVA,
            'Gs': row[4] / baseMVA,
            'Bs': row[5] / baseMVA,
            'vm': row[7],
            'va': row[8],
            'vmax': row[11],
            'vmin': row[12]
        }
        buses.append(bus)
    return buses

def parse_gen_data(gen_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse generator data - format: [bus, Pg, Qg, Qmax, Qmin, Vg, mBase, status, Pmax, Pmin, Pc1, Pc2]"""
    generators = []
    for i, row in enumerate(gen_list):
        gen = {
            'id': i + 1,
            'bus': int(row[0]),
            'Pg': row[1] / baseMVA,
            'Qg': row[2] / baseMVA,
            'Qmax': row[3] / baseMVA,
            'Qmin': row[4] / baseMVA,
            'Vg': row[5],
            'Pmax': row[8] / baseMVA,
            'Pmin': row[9] / baseMVA
        }
        generators.append(gen)
    return generators

def parse_gencost_data(gencost_list):
    """Parse generator cost data - format: [model, startup, shutdown, n, c(n-1), ..., c0]"""
    costs = []
    for row in gencost_list:
        model = int(row[0])
        n = int(row[3])
        if model == 2:  # Polynomial
            # Cost coefficients: c2, c1, c0 (or fewer if n < 3)
            c = [float(row[4 + i]) for i in range(n)]
            costs.append({'model': model, 'n': n, 'c': c})
        else:
            costs.append({'model': model, 'n': n, 'c': []})
    return costs

def parse_branch_data(branch_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse branch data - format: [from, to, r, x, b, rateA, rateB, rateC, ratio, angle, status, angmin, angmax]"""
    branches = []
    for i, row in enumerate(branch_list):
        branch = {
            'id': i + 1,
            'from_bus': int(row[0]),
            'to_bus': int(row[1]),
            'r': row[2],
            'x': row[3],
            'b': row[4],
            'rateA': row[5] / baseMVA,  # MVA limit in p.u.
            'rateB': row[6] / baseMVA,
            'rateC': row[7] / baseMVA,
            'ratio': row[8],  # Transformer tap ratio
            'angle': row[9] * np.pi / 180,  # Convert to radians
            'angmin': row[11] * np.pi / 180,
            'angmax': row[12] * np.pi / 180
        }
        branches.append(branch)
    return branches

def build_ybus(buses, branches):
    """Build bus admittance matrix"""
    n_buses = len(buses)
    ybus = np.zeros((n_buses, n_buses), dtype=complex)

    # Create bus index mapping
    bus_ids = {bus['id']: i for i, bus in enumerate(buses)}

    for branch in branches:
        f = bus_ids[branch['from_bus']]
        t = bus_ids[branch['to_bus']]

        r = branch['r']
        x = branch['x']
        z = r + 1j * x
        y = 1.0 / z

        tap = branch['ratio'] * np.exp(1j * branch['angle'])

        # Series admittance
        y_series = y

        # Shunt admittance
        b = branch['b']
        y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

        # Off-nominal tap
        if tap != 1.0:
            ybus[f, f] += y_series / (tap * np.conj(tap)) + y_shunt
            ybus[t, t] += y_series
            ybus[f, t] -= y_series / np.conj(tap)
            ybus[t, f] -= y_series / tap
        else:
            ybus[f, f] += y_series + y_shunt
            ybus[t, t] += y_series + y_shunt
            ybus[f, t] -= y_series
            ybus[t, f] -= y_series

    return ybus

def power_flow_equations(x, buses, generators, gencosts, ybus, baseMVA):
    """
    Compute power balance mismatches
    x = [Vm_1, ..., Vm_n, Va_1, ..., Va_n, Pg_1, ..., Pg_ng, Qg_1, ..., Qg_ng]
    """
    n_buses = len(buses)
    n_gens = len(generators)

    # Extract voltages
    Vm = x[:n_buses]
    Va = x[n_buses:2*n_buses]
    Pg = x[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
    Qg = x[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

    # Build voltage vector
    V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)

    # Compute complex power injection
    S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

    # Compute load
    S_load = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        S_load[i] = bus['Pd'] + 1j * bus['Qd']

    # Compute generator injection
    S_gen = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
        S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

    # Power mismatch (excluding reference bus)
    P_mismatch = []
    Q_mismatch = []
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        P_calc = S_inj[i].real + S_load[i].real - S_gen[i].real
        Q_calc = S_inj[i].imag + S_load[i].imag - S_gen[i].imag

        if bus['type'] == 3:  # Reference bus - don't include Q mismatch
            P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
        elif bus['type'] == 2:  # PV bus - don't include Q mismatch
            P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
        else:  # PQ bus
            P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
            Q_mismatch.append(Q_calc)

    return np.array(P_mismatch + Q_mismatch)

def cost_function(x, generators, gencosts):
    """Compute total generation cost"""
    n_buses = len(x) // 2  # Approximation
    n_gens = len(generators)

    Pg = x[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]

    total_cost = 0.0
    for k, (gen, cost) in enumerate(zip(generators, gencosts)):
        Pgpu = Pg[k]
        PgMW = Pgpu * 100.0  # Convert back to MW for cost calc

        # Polynomial cost: c2*Pg^2 + c1*Pg + c0
        if cost['n'] >= 3:
            total_cost += cost['c'][0] * PgMW**2 + cost['c'][1] * PgMW + cost['c'][2]
        elif cost['n'] == 2:
            total_cost += cost['c'][0] * PgMW + cost['c'][1]
        elif cost['n'] == 1:
            total_cost += cost['c'][0]

    return total_cost

def solve_acopf(buses, generators, gencosts, branches, ybus, baseMVA):
    """
    Solve AC Optimal Power Flow using sequential quadratic programming
    """
    n_buses = len(buses)
    n_gens = len(generators)

    # Identify reference bus
    ref_bus_idx = next(i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 3)

    # Initial guess
    Vm_init = np.array([bus['vm'] for bus in buses])

    Qg_init = np.array([gen['Qg'] for gen in generators])

    # Set reference bus angle to 0
    Va_init[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

    # Initial state vector (excluding reference bus angles and Q at PV buses)
    # We'll handle constraints differently

    x0 = np.concatenate([Vm_init, Va_init, Pg_init, Qg_init])

    # Create masks for variable indices
    Va_mask = np.ones(n_buses, dtype=bool)
    Va_mask[ref_bus_idx] = False

    PV_buses = [i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 2]
    PQ_buses = [i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 1]

    # Function to extract variables and compute mismatches
    def mismatch_and_cost(state):
        Vm = state[:n_buses]
        Va = state[n_buses:2*n_buses]
        Pg = state[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
        Qg = state[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

        for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
            bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
            S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

        # Power balance
        P_balance = np.real(S_inj) + Pd - np.real(S_gen)
        Q_balance = np.imag(S_inj) + Qd - np.imag(S_gen)

        # Mismatches for PQ and PV buses (P) and PQ buses (Q)

        # Q mismatch for PQ buses only

        # Cost

    # Use Newton-Raphson power flow as starting point, then optimize

    def objective_and_constraints(state):

            S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

        # Power balance constraints
        constraints = []

        # P balance for non-reference buses
        for i in range(n_buses):
            if i != ref_bus_idx:
                constraints.append({
                    'type': 'eq',
                    'fun': lambda s, idx=i: np.real(S_inj[idx]) + Pd[idx] - np.real(S_gen[idx])
                })

        # Q balance for PQ buses
        for i in PQ_buses:
            constraints.append({
                'type': 'eq',
                'fun': lambda s, idx=i: np.imag(S_inj[idx]) + Qd[idx] - np.imag(S_gen[idx])
            })

        # Cost
        cost = 0.0
        for k, cost_data in enumerate(gencosts):
            PgMW = Pg[k] * baseMVA
            if cost_data['n'] >= 3:
                c = cost_data['c']
                cost += c[0] * PgMW**2 + c[1] * PgMW + c[2]
            elif cost_data['n'] == 2:
                c = cost_data['c']
                cost += c[0] * PgMW + c[1]

        return cost, constraints

    # Simplified approach: Run power flow first, then economic dispatch
    # For this implementation, we'll use a more practical approach

    # Use scipy's minimize with constraints
    def objective(state):
        Vm = state[:n_buses]
        Va = state[n_buses:2*n_buses]
        Pg = state[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
        Qg = state[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

        cost = 0.0
        for k, cost_data in enumerate(gencosts):

            if cost_data['n'] >= 3:
                c = cost_data['c']
                cost += c[0] * PgMW**2 + c[1] * PgMW + c[2]
            elif cost_data['n'] == 2:
                c = cost_data['c']
                cost += c[0] * PgMW + c[1]

        return cost

    def eq_constraints(state):
        Vm = state[:n_buses]
        Va = state[n_buses:2*n_buses]
        Pg = state[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
        Qg = state[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0
        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)

        Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])

        for k, gen in enumerate(generators):

            S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

        cons = []

        # Q balance for PQ buses
        for i in PQ_buses:
            cons.append(np.imag(S_inj[i]) + Qd[i] - np.imag(S_gen[i]))

        return np.array(cons)

    # Bounds
    bounds = []

    # Vm bounds
    for bus in buses:
        bounds.append((bus['vmin'], bus['vmax']))

    # Va bounds (exclude reference)
    for i in range(n_buses):
        if i == ref_bus_idx:
            bounds.append((0.0, 0.0))  # Reference angle fixed
        else:
            bounds.append((-np.pi, np.pi))

    # Pg bounds
    for gen in generators:
        bounds.append((gen['Pmin'], gen['Pmax']))

    # Qg bounds
    for gen in generators:
        bounds.append((gen['Qmin'], gen['Qmax']))

    cons = []

    # P balance constraints
    for i in range(n_buses):

    # Q balance constraints
    for i, pq_idx in enumerate(PQ_buses):
        offset = n_buses - 1  # Number of P constraints
        cons.append({'type': 'eq', 'fun': lambda s, off=offset, pq=pq_idx: eq_constraints(s)[off + i]})

    try:
        result = minimize(
            objective,
            x0,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=bounds,
            constraints=cons,
            options={'ftol': 1e-9, 'maxiter': 1000, 'disp': False}
        )

        status = 'optimal' if result.success else 'infeasible'

        Vm = result.x[:n_buses]
        Va = result.x[n_buses:2*n_buses]
        Pg = result.x[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
        Qg = result.x[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Optimization failed: {e}")
        status = 'infeasible'
        Vm, Va, Pg, Qg = Vm_init, Va_init, Pg_init, Qg_init

    return {
        'Vm': Vm,
        'Va': Va,
        'Pg': Pg,
        'Qg': Qg,
        'status': status,
        'x_opt': result.x if 'result' in dir() else x0
    }

def compute_power_flow_solution(buses, generators, ybus, baseMVA, Vm_init, Va_init):
    """Run power flow to get consistent solution"""
    n_buses = len(buses)

    ref_bus_idx = next(i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 3)

    def power_mismatch(state):
        Vm = state[:n_buses]
        Va = state[n_buses:]
        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
        S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

        Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
        Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])

        # P mismatch for all buses except reference
        P_mismatch = []
        Q_mismatch = []

        for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
            P_calc = np.real(S_inj[i]) + Pd[i]
            Q_calc = np.imag(S_inj[i]) + Qd[i]

            if i == ref_bus_idx:
                P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
            else:
                P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
                Q_mismatch.append(Q_calc)

        return np.array(P_mismatch + Q_mismatch)

    # Newton-Raphson power flow
    state = np.concatenate([Vm_init, Va_init])

    for _ in range(100):
        mismatch = power_mismatch(state)
        if np.max(np.abs(mismatch)) < 1e-8:
            break

        # Jacobian
        # Simplified - using numerical derivatives
        eps = 1e-8
        J = np.zeros((2*n_buses - 1, 2*n_buses))

        for j in range(2*n_buses):
            state_plus = state.copy()
            state_plus[j] += eps
            mismatch_plus = power_mismatch(state_plus)
            J[:, j] = (mismatch_plus - mismatch) / eps

        # Solve for update
        try:
            delta = np.linalg.lstsq(J, -mismatch, rcond=None)[0]
            state += delta
        except:
            break

    return state

def compute_branch_flows(buses, branches, ybus, Vm, Va, baseMVA):
    """Compute branch power flows"""
    n_buses = len(buses)
    bus_ids = {bus['id']: i for i, bus in enumerate(buses)}

    branch_flows = []

    for branch in branches:
        f = bus_ids[branch['from_bus']]
        t = bus_ids[branch['to_bus']]

        Vf = Vm[f] * np.exp(1j * Va[f])
        Vt = Vm[t] * np.exp(1j * Va[t])

        # Series admittance
        z = branch['r'] + 1j * branch['x']
        y = 1.0 / z

        tap = branch['ratio'] * np.exp(1j * branch['angle'])

        if tap != 1.0:
            # Transformer
            S_from = (y * np.abs(Vf)**2 / np.abs(tap)**2 - y * Vf * np.conj(Vt) / np.conj(tap)) * baseMVA
            S_to = (y * np.abs(Vt)**2 - y * Vt * np.conj(Vf) / tap) * baseMVA
        else:
            S_from = (y * np.abs(Vf)**2 - y * Vf * np.conj(Vt)) * baseMVA
            S_to = (y * np.abs(Vt)**2 - y * Vt * np.conj(Vf)) * baseMVA

        loading = np.abs(S_from) / branch['rateA'] * 100 if branch['rateA'] > 0 else 0

        branch_flows.append({
            'from_bus': branch['from_bus'],
            'to_bus': branch['to_bus'],
            'flow_from_MVA': np.abs(S_from),
            'flow_to_MVA': np.abs(S_to),
            'loading_pct': loading,
            'limit_MVA': branch['rateA'] * baseMVA
        })

    return branch_flows

def main():
    # Load network data
    data = load_network('/root/network.json')

    baseMVA = data['baseMVA']

    # Parse data
    buses = parse_bus_data(data['bus'], baseMVA)
    generators = parse_gen_data(data['gen'], baseMVA)
    gencosts = parse_gencost_data(data['gencost'])
    branches = parse_branch_data(data['branch'], baseMVA)

    print(f"Network: {data['name']}")
    print(f"Base MVA: {baseMVA}")
    print(f"Buses: {len(buses)}, Generators: {len(generators)}, Branches: {len(branches)}")

    # Build Ybus
    ybus = build_ybus(buses, branches)

    # Solve AC OPF
    print("\nSolving AC Optimal Power Flow...")
    solution = solve_acopf(buses, generators, gencosts, branches, ybus, baseMVA)

    Vm = solution['Vm']
    Va = solution['Va'] * 180 / np.pi  # Convert to degrees
    Pg = solution['Pg'] * baseMVA  # Convert to MW
    Qg = solution['Qg'] * baseMVA  # Convert to MVAr

    # Compute branch flows
    branch_flows = compute_branch_flows(buses, branches, ybus, Vm, solution['Va'], baseMVA)

    # Compute totals
    total_Pg = np.sum(Pg)
    total_Qg = np.sum(Qg)
    total_Pd = sum(bus['Pd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses)
    total_Qd = sum(bus['Qd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses)
    total_losses = total_Pg - total_Pd

    # Compute cost
    total_cost = 0.0
    for k, cost in enumerate(gencosts):
        PgMW = Pg[k]
        if cost['n'] >= 3:
            c = cost['c']
            total_cost += c[0] * PgMW**2 + c[1] * PgMW + c[2]
        elif cost['n'] == 2:
            c = cost['c']
            total_cost += c[0] * PgMW + c[1]

    # Verify feasibility
    # Compute power mismatches
    V = Vm * np.exp(1j * solution['Va'] * np.pi / 180)
    S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

    Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses])
    Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses])

    # Generator injection at buses
    S_gen = np.zeros(len(buses), dtype=complex)
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
        S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

    P_mismatch = np.real(S_inj) + Pd - np.real(S_gen)
    Q_mismatch = np.imag(S_inj) + Qd - np.imag(S_gen)

    max_P_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(P_mismatch))
    max_Q_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(Q_mismatch))

    # Voltage violations
    v_violations = []
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        if Vm[i] < bus['vmin'] or Vm[i] > bus['vmax']:
            v_violations.append(abs(Vm[i] - bus['vmin']) if Vm[i] < bus['vmin'] else abs(Vm[i] - bus['vmax']))
    max_v_violation = max(v_violations) if v_violations else 0.0

    # Branch overloads
    overloads = []
    for bf in branch_flows:
        if bf['flow_from_MVA'] > bf['limit_MVA']:
            overloads.append(bf['flow_from_MVA'] - bf['limit_MVA'])
    max_overload = max(overloads) if overloads else 0.0

    # Build report
    report = {
        "summary": {
            "total_cost_per_hour": round(total_cost, 2),
            "total_load_MW": round(total_Pd, 2),
            "total_load_MVAr": round(total_Qd, 2),
            "total_generation_MW": round(total_Pg, 2),
            "total_generation_MVAr": round(total_Qg, 2),
            "total_losses_MW": round(total_losses, 2),
            "solver_status": solution['status']
        },
        "generators": [],
        "buses": [],
        "most_loaded_branches": [],
        "feasibility_check": {
            "max_p_mismatch_MW": round(max_P_mismatch, 6),
            "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": round(max_Q_mismatch, 6),
            "max_voltage_violation_pu": round(max_v_violation, 6),
            "max_branch_overload_MVA": round(max_overload, 6)
        }
    }

    # Add generators
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        report["generators"].append({
            "id": gen['id'],
            "bus": gen['bus'],
            "pg_MW": round(Pg[k], 4),
            "qg_MVAr": round(Qg[k], 4),
            "pmin_MW": round(gen['Pmin'] * baseMVA, 4),
            "pmax_MW": round(gen['Pmax'] * baseMVA, 4),
            "qmin_MVAr": round(gen['Qmin'] * baseMVA, 4),
            "qmax_MVAr": round(gen['Qmax'] * baseMVA, 4)
        })

    # Add buses
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        report["buses"].append({
            "id": bus['id'],
            "vm_pu": round(Vm[i], 6),
            "va_deg": round(Va[i], 4),
            "vmin_pu": bus['vmin'],
            "vmax_pu": bus['vmax']
        })

    # Sort branches by loading and add top 10 most loaded
    sorted_branches = sorted(branch_flows, key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)[:10]
    for bf in sorted_branches:
        report["most_loaded_branches"].append({
            "from_bus": int(bf['from_bus']),
            "to_bus": int(bf['to_bus']),
            "loading_pct": round(bf['loading_pct'], 2),
            "flow_from_MVA": round(bf['flow_from_MVA'], 4),
            "flow_to_MVA": round(bf['flow_to_MVA'], 4),
            "limit_MVA": round(bf['limit_MVA'], 4)
        })

    # Write report
    with open('/root/report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("AC OPF SOLUTION COMPLETE")
    print("="*60)
    print(f"Total Cost: ${total_cost:,.2f}/hr")
    print(f"Total Generation: {total_Pg:.2f} MW, {total_Qg:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"Total Load: {total_Pd:.2f} MW, {total_Qd:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"Total Losses: {total_losses:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Solver Status: {solution['status']}")
    print(f"\nFeasibility:")
    print(f"  Max P mismatch: {max_P_mismatch:.6f} MW")
    print(f"  Max Q mismatch: {max_Q_mismatch:.6f} MVAr")
    print(f"  Max voltage violation: {max_v_violation:.6f} pu")
    print(f"  Max branch overload: {max_overload:.6f} MVA")
    print(f"\nReport saved to /root/report.json")

    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC OPF) Solver
Based on the mathematical model in math-model.md
Minimizes generation cost subject to AC power flow constraints
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix, diags
import cmath

def load_network(filepath):
    """Load network data from JSON file (MATPOWER format)"""
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    return data

def parse_bus_data(bus_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse bus data - format: [id, type, Pd, Qd, Gs, Bs, area, vm, va, baseKV, zone, vmax, vmin]"""
    buses = []
    for row in bus_list:
        bus = {
            'id': int(row[0]),
            'type': int(row[1]),  # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=ref
            'Pd': row[2] / baseMVA,  # Convert to p.u.
            'Qd': row[3] / baseMVA,
            'Gs': row[4] / baseMVA,
            'Bs': row[5] / baseMVA,
            'vm': row[7],
            'va': row[8],
            'vmax': row[11],
            'vmin': row[12]
        }
        buses.append(bus)
    return buses

def parse_gen_data(gen_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse generator data - format: [bus, Pg, Qg, Qmax, Qmin, Vg, mBase, status, Pmax, Pmin, Pc1, Pc2]"""
    generators = []
    for i, row in enumerate(gen_list):
        gen = {
            'id': i + 1,
            'bus': int(row[0]),
            'Pg': row[1] / baseMVA,
            'Qg': row[2] / baseMVA,
            'Qmax': row[3] / baseMVA,
            'Qmin': row[4] / baseMVA,
            'Vg': row[5],
            'Pmax': row[8] / baseMVA,
            'Pmin': row[9] / baseMVA
        }
        generators.append(gen)
    return generators

def parse_gencost_data(gencost_list):
    """Parse generator cost data - format: [model, startup, shutdown, n, c(n-1), ..., c0]"""
    costs = []
    for row in gencost_list:
        model = int(row[0])
        n = int(row[3])
        if model == 2:  # Polynomial
            # Cost coefficients: c2, c1, c0 (or fewer if n < 3)
            c = [float(row[4 + i]) for i in range(n)]
            costs.append({'model': model, 'n': n, 'c': c})
        else:
            costs.append({'model': model, 'n': n, 'c': []})
    return costs

def parse_branch_data(branch_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse branch data - format: [from, to, r, x, b, rateA, rateB, rateC, ratio, angle, status, angmin, angmax]"""
    branches = []
    for i, row in enumerate(branch_list):
        branch = {
            'id': i + 1,
            'from_bus': int(row[0]),
            'to_bus': int(row[1]),
            'r': row[2],
            'x': row[3],
            'b': row[4],
            'rateA': row[5] / baseMVA,  # MVA limit in p.u.
            'rateB': row[6] / baseMVA,
            'rateC': row[7] / baseMVA,
            'ratio': row[8],  # Transformer tap ratio
            'angle': row[9] * np.pi / 180,  # Convert to radians
            'angmin': row[11] * np.pi / 180,
            'angmax': row[12] * np.pi / 180
        }
        branches.append(branch)
    return branches

def build_ybus(buses, branches):
    """Build bus admittance matrix"""
    n_buses = len(buses)
    ybus = np.zeros((n_buses, n_buses), dtype=complex)

    # Create bus index mapping
    bus_ids = {bus['id']: i for i, bus in enumerate(buses)}

    for branch in branches:
        f = bus_ids[branch['from_bus']]
        t = bus_ids[branch['to_bus']]

        r = branch['r']
        x = branch['x']
        z = r + 1j * x
        y = 1.0 / z

        tap = branch['ratio'] * np.exp(1j * branch['angle'])

        # Series admittance
        y_series = y

        # Shunt admittance
        b = branch['b']
        y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

        # Off-nominal tap
        if tap != 1.0:
            ybus[f, f] += y_series / (tap * np.conj(tap)) + y_shunt
            ybus[t, t] += y_series
            ybus[f, t] -= y_series / np.conj(tap)
            ybus[t, f] -= y_series / tap
        else:
            ybus[f, f] += y_series + y_shunt
            ybus[t, t] += y_series + y_shunt
            ybus[f, t] -= y_series
            ybus[t, f] -= y_series

    return ybus

def power_flow_equations(x, buses, generators, gencosts, ybus, baseMVA):
    """
    Compute power balance mismatches
    x = [Vm_1, ..., Vm_n, Va_1, ..., Va_n, Pg_1, ..., Pg_ng, Qg_1, ..., Qg_ng]
