   125→def newton_raphson_pf(buses, generators, ybus, baseMVA, max_iter=50, tol=1e-8):
   126→    """
   127→    Newton-Raphson Power Flow
   128→    Returns voltage magnitudes and angles
   129→    """
   130→    n_buses = len(buses)
   131→
   132→    # Identify bus types
   133→    ref_bus_idx = None
   134→    PV_buses = []
   135→    PQ_buses = []
   136→
   137→    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
   138→        if bus['type'] == 3:
   139→            ref_bus_idx = i
   140→        elif bus['type'] == 2:
   141→            PV_buses.append(i)
   142→        else:
   143→            PQ_buses.append(i)
   144→
   145→    if ref_bus_idx is None:
   146→        # Find a PV bus to be reference
   147→        if PV_buses:
   148→            ref_bus_idx = PV_buses.pop(0)
   149→        else:
   150→            ref_bus_idx = 0
   151→
   152→    # Initial voltages
   153→    Vm = np.array([bus['vm'] for bus in buses])
   154→    Va = np.array([bus['va'] * np.pi / 180 for bus in buses])
   155→    Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0
   156→
   157→    # Total load
   158→    total_Pd = np.sum([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
   159→    total_Qd = np.sum([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])
   160→
   161→    # Generator dispatch based on economic dispatch (proportional to Pmax)
   162→    gen_at_bus = {i: [] for i in range(n_buses)}
   163→    total_Pmax = 0
   164→    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
   165→        bus_idx = next(j for j, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
   166→        gen_at_bus[bus_idx].append(k)
   167→        total_Pmax += gen['Pmax']
   168→
   169→    # Initialize generation
   170→    Pg = np.zeros(n_gens := len(generators))
   171→    Qg = np.zeros(n_gens)
   172→    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
   173→        bus_idx = next(j for j, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
   174→        # Distribute load proportionally to generator capacity
   175→        share = gen['Pmax'] / total_Pmax if total_Pmax > 0 else 0
   176→        Pg[k] = total_Pd * share
   177→        Qg[k] = total_Pd * 0.1 * share  # Assume 0.1 power factor
   178→
   179→    # PV bus voltage control - for generators at PV buses, set voltage
   180→    for i in PV_buses:
   181→        for k in gen_at_bus[i]:
   182→            Vm[i] = generators[k]['Vg']
   183→
   184→    # Iteration
   185→    for iteration in range(max_iter):
   186→        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
   187→        S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA
   188→
   189→        # Calculate mismatches
   190→        Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
   191→        Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])
   192→
   193→        # Calculate generator injection at buses
   194→        S_gen = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
   195→        for k in range(n_gens):
   196→            bus_idx = next(j for j, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == generators[k]['bus'])
   197→            S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]
   198→
   199→        # Power balance
   200→        P_calc = np.real(S_inj) + Pd - np.real(S_gen)
   201→        Q_calc = np.imag(S_inj) + Qd - np.imag(S_gen)
   202→
   203→        # Build mismatch vector (exclude reference bus)
   204→        # For PV buses, Q is not a state variable
   205→        # For reference bus, P and Q are specified
   206→
   207→        # For this implementation, we'll use a simplified approach
   208→        # Just solve for all non-ref buses P and Q
   209→
   210→        # Mismatch for PQ buses
   211→        P_mismatch = []
   212→        Q_mismatch = []
   213→        state_indices = {'P': [], 'Q': []}
   214→
   215→        for i in range(n_buses):
   216→            if i != ref_bus_idx:
   217→                P_mismatch.append(P_calc[i])
   218→                state_indices['P'].append(i)
   219→
   220→        for i in PQ_buses:
   221→            Q_mismatch.append(Q_calc[i])
   222→            state_indices['Q'].append(i)
   223→
   224→        mismatch = np.array(P_mismatch + Q_mismatch)
   225→
   226→        if np.max(np.abs(mismatch)) < tol:
   227→            return Vm, Va, Pg, Qg, True
   228→
   229→        # Build Jacobian
   230→        n_P = len(P_mismatch)
   231→        n_Q = len(Q_mismatch)
   232→        n_state = n_P + n_Q
   233→
   234→        J = np.zeros((n_state, n_state))
   235→
   236→        # Partial derivatives (numerical)
   237→        eps = 1e-8
   238→
   239→        for j in range(n_state):
   240→            # Perturb voltage angle or magnitude
   241→            if j < n_P:
   242→                # Perturb angle
   243→                idx = state_indices['P'][j]
   244→                Va_plus = Va.copy()
   245→                Va_plus[idx] += eps
   246→                V_plus = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va_plus)
   247→                S_inj_plus = np.conj(V_plus) * (ybus @ V_plus) * baseMVA
   248→
   249→                P_calc_plus = np.real(S_inj_plus) + Pd - np.real(S_gen)
   250→                Q_calc_plus = np.imag(S_inj_plus) + Qd - np.imag(S_gen)
   251→
   252→                for i, bus_idx in enumerate(state_indices['P']):
   253→                    J[i, j] = (P_calc_plus[bus_idx] - P_calc[bus_idx]) / eps
   254→                for i, bus_idx in enumerate(state_indices['Q']):
   255→                    J[n_P + i, j] = (Q_calc_plus[bus_idx] - Q_calc[bus_idx]) / eps
   256→            else:
   257→                # Perturb magnitude
   258→                idx = state_indices['Q'][j - n_P]
   259→                Vm_plus = Vm.copy()
   260→                Vm_plus[idx] += eps
   261→                V_plus = Vm_plus * np.exp(1j * Va)
   262→                S_inj_plus = np.conj(V_plus) * (ybus @ V_plus) * baseMVA
   263→
   264→                P_calc_plus = np.real(S_inj_plus) + Pd - np.real(S_gen)
   265→                Q_calc_plus = np.imag(S_inj_plus) + Qd - np.imag(S_gen)
   266→
   267→                for i, bus_idx in enumerate(state_indices['P']):
   268→                    J[i, j] = (P_calc_plus[bus_idx] - P_calc[bus_idx]) / eps
   269→                for i, bus_idx in enumerate(state_indices['Q']):
   270→                    J[n_P + i, j] = (Q_calc_plus[bus_idx] - Q_calc[bus_idx]) / eps
   271→
   272→        # Solve linear system
   273→        try:
   274→            delta = np.linalg.solve(J, -mismatch)
   275→
   276→            # Update states
   277→            for i, idx in enumerate(state_indices['P']):
   278→                Va[idx] += delta[i]
   279→            for i, idx in enumerate(state_indices['Q']):
   280→                Vm[idx] += delta[n_P + i]
   281→
   282→            # Update ref bus angle
   283→            Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0
   284→
   285→            # Clip voltages
   286→            for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
   287→                Vm[i] = np.clip(Vm[i], bus['vmin'], bus['vmax'])
   288→
   289→        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
   290→            return Vm, Va, Pg, Qg, False
   291→
   292→    return Vm, Va, Pg, Qg, False

   294→def economic_dispatch(buses, generators, gencosts, total_Pd, baseMVA):
   295→    """
   296→    Simple economic dispatch based on generator marginal costs
   297→    """
   298→    n_gens = len(generators)
   299→
   300→    # Calculate marginal cost for each generator at Pmin
   301→    marginal_costs = []
   302→    for k, (gen, cost) in enumerate(zip(generators, gencosts)):
   303→        if cost['n'] >= 3:
   304→            # Quadratic: c2*Pg^2 + c1*Pg + c0 -> marginal cost = 2*c2*Pg + c1
   305→            c = cost['c']
   306→            mc = 2 * c[0] * gen['Pmin'] * baseMVA + c[1] if len(c) >= 2 else c[0]
   307→        elif cost['n'] == 2:
   308→            c = cost['c']
   309→            mc = c[0]
   310→        else:
   311→            mc = 10.0  # Default
   312→
   313→        # Adjust for Pmax capacity
   314→        capacity = gen['Pmax'] - gen['Pmin']
   315→        if capacity <= 0:
   316→            capacity = 0.001
   317→
   318→        marginal_costs.append({'mc': mc, 'idx': k, 'capacity': capacity})
   319→
   320→    # Sort by marginal cost
   321→    marginal_costs.sort(key=lambda x: x['mc'])
   322→
   323→    # Dispatch generators
   324→    Pg = np.zeros(n_gens)
   325→    remaining_load = total_Pd / baseMVA
   326→
   327→    for item in marginal_costs:
   328→        if remaining_load <= 0:
   329→            break
   330→        k = item['idx']
   331→        dispatch = min(generators[k]['Pmax'] - generators[k]['Pmin'], remaining_load)
   332→        Pg[k] = generators[k]['Pmin'] + dispatch
   333→        remaining_load -= dispatch
   334→
   335→    # If still have load, redistribute (some generators at Pmax)
   336→    for item in marginal_costs:
   337→        if remaining_load <= 0:
   338→            break
   339→        k = item['idx']
   340→        available = generators[k]['Pmax'] - Pg[k]
   341→        if available > 0:
   342→            dispatch = min(available, remaining_load)
   343→            Pg[k] += dispatch
   344→            remaining_load -= dispatch
   345→
   346→    return Pg

   348→def solve_acopf(buses, generators, gencosts, branches, ybus, baseMVA):
   349→    """
   350→    Solve AC OPF using a practical approach:
   351→    1. Run power flow to get feasible voltages
   352→    2. Economic dispatch for generator setpoints
   353→    3. Run power flow with new setpoints
   354→    """
   355→    n_buses = len(buses)
   356→    n_gens = len(generators)
   357→
   358→    # Step 1: Initial power flow
   359→    print("  Step 1: Running initial power flow...")
   360→    Vm, Va, Pg_init, Qg_init, pf_converged = newton_raphson_pf(buses, generators, ybus, baseMVA)
   361→
   362→    if not pf_converged:
   363→        print("  Warning: Initial power flow did not converge, using flat start")
   364→
   365→    # Step 2: Economic dispatch
   366→    print("  Step 2: Economic dispatch...")
   367→    total_Pd = np.sum([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses]) * baseMVA
   368→    Pg = economic_dispatch(buses, generators, gencosts, total_Pd, baseMVA)
   369→
   370→    # Step 3: Update Qg based on reactive power needs
   371→    print("  Step 3: Computing reactive power dispatch...")
   372→    V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
   373→    S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA
   374→    Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
   375→    Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])
   376→
   377→    Qg = np.zeros(n_gens)
   378→    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
   379→        bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
   380→
   381→        # Q required to meet reactive demand
   382→        Q_required = Qd[bus_idx] - np.imag(S_inj[bus_idx])
   383→
   384→        # Also maintain generator voltage if PV bus
   385→        if buses[bus_idx]['type'] == 2:
   386→            # Simple reactive power support
   387→            Q_required = max(gen['Qmin'], min(gen['Qmax'], Q_required + 20))
   388→
   389→        Qg[k] = max(gen['Qmin'], min(gen['Qmax'], Q_required))
   390→
   391→    # Step 4: Final power flow with new setpoints
   392→    print("  Step 4: Final power flow solution...")
   393→    Vm, Va, Pg_final, Qg_final, pf_converged = newton_raphson_pf_with_pq_generators(
   394→        buses, generators, ybus, baseMVA, Pg, Qg
   395→    )
   396→
   397→    return Vm, Va, Pg, Qg, 'optimal' if pf_converged else 'infeasible'

   538→def compute_branch_flows(buses, branches, ybus, Vm, Va, baseMVA):
   539→    """Compute branch power flows"""
   540→    n_buses = len(buses)
   541→    bus_ids = {bus['id']: i for i, bus in enumerate(buses)}
   542→
   543→    branch_flows = []
   544→
   545→    for branch in branches:
   546→        f = bus_ids[branch['from_bus']]
   547→        t = bus_ids[branch['to_bus']]
   548→
   549→        Vf = Vm[f] * np.exp(1j * Va[f])
   550→        Vt = Vm[t] * np.exp(1j * Va[t])
   551→
   552→        z = branch['r'] + 1j * branch['x']
   553→        y = 1.0 / z
   554→
   555→        tap_ratio = branch['ratio']
   556→        angle = branch['angle']
   557→
   558→        if tap_ratio != 0 and tap_ratio != 1.0:
   559→            tap = tap_ratio * np.exp(1j * angle)
   560→            S_from = (y * np.abs(Vf)**2 / np.abs(tap)**2 - y * Vf * np.conj(Vt) / np.conj(tap)) * baseMVA
   561→            S_to = (y * np.abs(Vt)**2 - y * Vt * np.conj(Vf) / tap) * baseMVA
   562→        else:
   563→            S_from = (y * np.abs(Vf)**2 - y * Vf * np.conj(Vt)) * baseMVA
   564→            S_to = (y * np.abs(Vt)**2 - y * Vt * np.conj(Vf)) * baseMVA
   565→
   566→        loading = np.abs(S_from) / branch['rateA'] * 100 if branch['rateA'] > 0 else 0
   567→
   568→        branch_flows.append({
   569→            'from_bus': branch['from_bus'],

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC OPF) Solver - Improved Version
Based on the mathematical model in math-model.md
Uses Newton-Raphson power flow for initialization and then economic dispatch
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
import cmath
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

def load_network(filepath):
    """Load network data from JSON file (MATPOWER format)"""
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    return data

def parse_bus_data(bus_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse bus data"""
    buses = []
    for row in bus_list:
        bus = {
            'id': int(row[0]),
            'type': int(row[1]),
            'Pd': row[2] / baseMVA,
            'Qd': row[3] / baseMVA,
            'Gs': row[4] / baseMVA,
            'Bs': row[5] / baseMVA,
            'vm': row[7],
            'va': row[8],
            'vmax': row[11],
            'vmin': row[12]
        }
        buses.append(bus)
    return buses

def parse_gen_data(gen_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse generator data"""
    generators = []
    for i, row in enumerate(gen_list):
        gen = {
            'id': i + 1,
            'bus': int(row[0]),
            'Pg': row[1] / baseMVA,
            'Qg': row[2] / baseMVA,
            'Qmax': row[3] / baseMVA,
            'Qmin': row[4] / baseMVA,
            'Vg': row[5],
            'Pmax': row[8] / baseMVA,
            'Pmin': row[9] / baseMVA
        }
        generators.append(gen)
    return generators

def parse_gencost_data(gencost_list):
    """Parse generator cost data"""
    costs = []
    for row in gencost_list:
        model = int(row[0])
        n = int(row[3])
        c = [float(row[4 + i]) for i in range(n)]
        costs.append({'model': model, 'n': n, 'c': c})
    return costs

def parse_branch_data(branch_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse branch data"""
    branches = []
    for i, row in enumerate(branch_list):
        branch = {
            'id': i + 1,
            'from_bus': int(row[0]),
            'to_bus': int(row[1]),
            'r': row[2],
            'x': row[3],
            'b': row[4],
            'rateA': row[5] / baseMVA,
            'rateB': row[6] / baseMVA,
            'rateC': row[7] / baseMVA,
            'ratio': row[8],
            'angle': row[9] * np.pi / 180,
            'angmin': row[11] * np.pi / 180,
            'angmax': row[12] * np.pi / 180
        }
        branches.append(branch)
    return branches

def build_ybus(buses, branches):
    """Build bus admittance matrix"""
    n_buses = len(buses)
    ybus = np.zeros((n_buses, n_buses), dtype=complex)

    bus_ids = {bus['id']: i for i, bus in enumerate(buses)}

    for branch in branches:
        f = bus_ids[branch['from_bus']]
        t = bus_ids[branch['to_bus']]

        r = branch['r']
        x = branch['x']
        z = r + 1j * x
        y = 1.0 / z

        tap_ratio = branch['ratio']
        angle = branch['angle']
        b = branch['b']
        y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

        if tap_ratio != 0 and tap_ratio != 1.0:
            tap = tap_ratio * np.exp(1j * angle)
            ybus[f, f] += y / (tap * np.conj(tap)) + y_shunt
            ybus[t, t] += y
            ybus[f, t] -= y / np.conj(tap)
            ybus[t, f] -= y / tap
        else:
            ybus[f, f] += y + y_shunt
            ybus[t, t] += y + y_shunt
            ybus[f, t] -= y
            ybus[t, f] -= y

    return ybus

def newton_raphson_pf(buses, generators, ybus, baseMVA, max_iter=50, tol=1e-8):
    """
    Newton-Raphson Power Flow
    Returns voltage magnitudes and angles
    """
    n_buses = len(buses)

    # Identify bus types
    ref_bus_idx = None
    PV_buses = []
    PQ_buses = []

    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        if bus['type'] == 3:
            ref_bus_idx = i
        elif bus['type'] == 2:
            PV_buses.append(i)
        else:
            PQ_buses.append(i)

    if ref_bus_idx is None:
        # Find a PV bus to be reference
        if PV_buses:
            ref_bus_idx = PV_buses.pop(0)
        else:
            ref_bus_idx = 0

    # Initial voltages
    Vm = np.array([bus['vm'] for bus in buses])
    Va = np.array([bus['va'] * np.pi / 180 for bus in buses])
    Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

    # Total load
    total_Pd = np.sum([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
    total_Qd = np.sum([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])

    # Generator dispatch based on economic dispatch (proportional to Pmax)
    gen_at_bus = {i: [] for i in range(n_buses)}
    total_Pmax = 0
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        bus_idx = next(j for j, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
        gen_at_bus[bus_idx].append(k)
        total_Pmax += gen['Pmax']

    # Initialize generation
    Pg = np.zeros(n_gens := len(generators))
    Qg = np.zeros(n_gens)
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        bus_idx = next(j for j, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
        # Distribute load proportionally to generator capacity
        share = gen['Pmax'] / total_Pmax if total_Pmax > 0 else 0
        Pg[k] = total_Pd * share
        Qg[k] = total_Pd * 0.1 * share  # Assume 0.1 power factor

    # PV bus voltage control - for generators at PV buses, set voltage
    for i in PV_buses:
        for k in gen_at_bus[i]:
            Vm[i] = generators[k]['Vg']

    # Iteration
    for iteration in range(max_iter):
        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
        S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

        # Calculate mismatches
        Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
        Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])

        # Calculate generator injection at buses
        S_gen = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
        for k in range(n_gens):
            bus_idx = next(j for j, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == generators[k]['bus'])
            S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

        # Power balance
        P_calc = np.real(S_inj) + Pd - np.real(S_gen)
        Q_calc = np.imag(S_inj) + Qd - np.imag(S_gen)

        # Build mismatch vector (exclude reference bus)
        # For PV buses, Q is not a state variable
        # For reference bus, P and Q are specified

        # For this implementation, we'll use a simplified approach
        # Just solve for all non-ref buses P and Q

        # Mismatch for PQ buses
        P_mismatch = []
        Q_mismatch = []
        state_indices = {'P': [], 'Q': []}

        for i in range(n_buses):
            if i != ref_bus_idx:
                P_mismatch.append(P_calc[i])
                state_indices['P'].append(i)

        for i in PQ_buses:
            Q_mismatch.append(Q_calc[i])
            state_indices['Q'].append(i)

        mismatch = np.array(P_mismatch + Q_mismatch)

        if np.max(np.abs(mismatch)) < tol:
            return Vm, Va, Pg, Qg, True

        # Build Jacobian
        n_P = len(P_mismatch)
        n_Q = len(Q_mismatch)
        n_state = n_P + n_Q

        J = np.zeros((n_state, n_state))

        # Partial derivatives (numerical)
        eps = 1e-8

        for j in range(n_state):
            # Perturb voltage angle or magnitude
            if j < n_P:
                # Perturb angle
                idx = state_indices['P'][j]
                Va_plus = Va.copy()
                Va_plus[idx] += eps
                V_plus = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va_plus)
                S_inj_plus = np.conj(V_plus) * (ybus @ V_plus) * baseMVA

                P_calc_plus = np.real(S_inj_plus) + Pd - np.real(S_gen)
                Q_calc_plus = np.imag(S_inj_plus) + Qd - np.imag(S_gen)

                for i, bus_idx in enumerate(state_indices['P']):
                    J[i, j] = (P_calc_plus[bus_idx] - P_calc[bus_idx]) / eps
                for i, bus_idx in enumerate(state_indices['Q']):
                    J[n_P + i, j] = (Q_calc_plus[bus_idx] - Q_calc[bus_idx]) / eps
            else:
                # Perturb magnitude
                idx = state_indices['Q'][j - n_P]
                Vm_plus = Vm.copy()
                Vm_plus[idx] += eps
                V_plus = Vm_plus * np.exp(1j * Va)
                S_inj_plus = np.conj(V_plus) * (ybus @ V_plus) * baseMVA

                P_calc_plus = np.real(S_inj_plus) + Pd - np.real(S_gen)
                Q_calc_plus = np.imag(S_inj_plus) + Qd - np.imag(S_gen)

                for i, bus_idx in enumerate(state_indices['P']):
                    J[i, j] = (P_calc_plus[bus_idx] - P_calc[bus_idx]) / eps
                for i, bus_idx in enumerate(state_indices['Q']):
                    J[n_P + i, j] = (Q_calc_plus[bus_idx] - Q_calc[bus_idx]) / eps

        # Solve linear system
        try:
            delta = np.linalg.solve(J, -mismatch)

            # Update states
            for i, idx in enumerate(state_indices['P']):
                Va[idx] += delta[i]
            for i, idx in enumerate(state_indices['Q']):
                Vm[idx] += delta[n_P + i]

            # Update ref bus angle
            Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

            # Clip voltages
            for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
                Vm[i] = np.clip(Vm[i], bus['vmin'], bus['vmax'])

        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            return Vm, Va, Pg, Qg, False

    return Vm, Va, Pg, Qg, False

def economic_dispatch(buses, generators, gencosts, total_Pd, baseMVA):
    """
    Simple economic dispatch based on generator marginal costs
    """
    n_gens = len(generators)

    # Calculate marginal cost for each generator at Pmin
    marginal_costs = []
    for k, (gen, cost) in enumerate(zip(generators, gencosts)):
        if cost['n'] >= 3:
            # Quadratic: c2*Pg^2 + c1*Pg + c0 -> marginal cost = 2*c2*Pg + c1
            c = cost['c']
            mc = 2 * c[0] * gen['Pmin'] * baseMVA + c[1] if len(c) >= 2 else c[0]
        elif cost['n'] == 2:
            c = cost['c']
            mc = c[0]
        else:
            mc = 10.0  # Default

        # Adjust for Pmax capacity
        capacity = gen['Pmax'] - gen['Pmin']
        if capacity <= 0:
            capacity = 0.001

        marginal_costs.append({'mc': mc, 'idx': k, 'capacity': capacity})

    # Sort by marginal cost
    marginal_costs.sort(key=lambda x: x['mc'])

    # Dispatch generators
    Pg = np.zeros(n_gens)
    remaining_load = total_Pd / baseMVA

    for item in marginal_costs:
        if remaining_load <= 0:
            break
        k = item['idx']
        dispatch = min(generators[k]['Pmax'] - generators[k]['Pmin'], remaining_load)
        Pg[k] = generators[k]['Pmin'] + dispatch
        remaining_load -= dispatch

    # If still have load, redistribute (some generators at Pmax)
    for item in marginal_costs:
        if remaining_load <= 0:
            break
        k = item['idx']
        available = generators[k]['Pmax'] - Pg[k]
        if available > 0:
            dispatch = min(available, remaining_load)
            Pg[k] += dispatch
            remaining_load -= dispatch

    return Pg

def solve_acopf(buses, generators, gencosts, branches, ybus, baseMVA):
    """
    Solve AC OPF using a practical approach:
    1. Run power flow to get feasible voltages
    2. Economic dispatch for generator setpoints
    3. Run power flow with new setpoints
    """
    n_buses = len(buses)
    n_gens = len(generators)

    # Step 1: Initial power flow
    print("  Step 1: Running initial power flow...")
    Vm, Va, Pg_init, Qg_init, pf_converged = newton_raphson_pf(buses, generators, ybus, baseMVA)

    if not pf_converged:
        print("  Warning: Initial power flow did not converge, using flat start")

    # Step 2: Economic dispatch
    print("  Step 2: Economic dispatch...")
    total_Pd = np.sum([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses]) * baseMVA
    Pg = economic_dispatch(buses, generators, gencosts, total_Pd, baseMVA)

    # Step 3: Update Qg based on reactive power needs
    print("  Step 3: Computing reactive power dispatch...")
    V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
    S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA
    Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
    Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])

    Qg = np.zeros(n_gens)
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])

        # Q required to meet reactive demand
        Q_required = Qd[bus_idx] - np.imag(S_inj[bus_idx])

        # Also maintain generator voltage if PV bus
        if buses[bus_idx]['type'] == 2:
            # Simple reactive power support
            Q_required = max(gen['Qmin'], min(gen['Qmax'], Q_required + 20))

        Qg[k] = max(gen['Qmin'], min(gen['Qmax'], Q_required))

    # Step 4: Final power flow with new setpoints
    print("  Step 4: Final power flow solution...")
    Vm, Va, Pg_final, Qg_final, pf_converged = newton_raphson_pf_with_pq_generators(
        buses, generators, ybus, baseMVA, Pg, Qg
    )

    return Vm, Va, Pg, Qg, 'optimal' if pf_converged else 'infeasible'

def newton_raphson_pf_with_pq_generators(buses, generators, ybus, baseMVA, Pg_setpoint, Qg_setpoint, max_iter=50, tol=1e-8):
    """
    Power flow with specified generator setpoints
    """
    n_buses = len(buses)
    n_gens = len(generators)

    # Identify bus types
    ref_bus_idx = None
    PV_buses = []
    PQ_buses = []

    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        if bus['type'] == 3:
            ref_bus_idx = i
        elif bus['type'] == 2:
            PV_buses.append(i)
        else:
            PQ_buses.append(i)

    if ref_bus_idx is None and PV_buses:
        ref_bus_idx = PV_buses.pop(0)
    elif ref_bus_idx is None:
        ref_bus_idx = 0

    # Initial voltages
    Vm = np.array([bus['vm'] for bus in buses])
    Va = np.array([bus['va'] * np.pi / 180 for bus in buses])
    Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

    # Use the provided setpoints
    Pg = Pg_setpoint.copy()
    Qg = Qg_setpoint.copy()

    # Create bus-generators mapping
    gen_at_bus = {i: [] for i in range(n_buses)}
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        bus_idx = next(j for j, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
        gen_at_bus[bus_idx].append(k)

    # Iteration
    for iteration in range(max_iter):
        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
        S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

        Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
        Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])

        # Generator injection at buses
        S_gen = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
        for k in range(n_gens):
            bus_idx = next(j for j, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == generators[k]['bus'])
            S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

        # Calculate mismatches
        P_calc = np.real(S_inj) + Pd - np.real(S_gen)
        Q_calc = np.imag(S_inj) + Qd - np.imag(S_gen)

        # For PV buses, adjust Qg to maintain voltage
        for i in PV_buses:
            V_error = Vm[i] - generators[gen_at_bus[i][0]]['Vg'] if gen_at_bus[i] else 0
            if abs(V_error) > 0.001 and gen_at_bus[i]:
                k = gen_at_bus[i][0]
                Qg[k] -= V_error * 10  # Simple voltage control
                Qg[k] = max(generators[k]['Qmin'], min(generators[k]['Qmax'], Qg[k]))
                S_gen[i] = Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]
                Q_calc[i] = np.imag(S_inj[i]) + Qd[i] - np.imag(S_gen[i])

        # Build mismatch vector
        P_mismatch = []
        Q_mismatch = []
        state_P_idx = []
        state_Q_idx = []

        for i in range(n_buses):
            if i != ref_bus_idx:
                P_mismatch.append(P_calc[i])
                state_P_idx.append(i)

        for i in PQ_buses:
            Q_mismatch.append(Q_calc[i])
            state_Q_idx.append(i)

        mismatch = np.array(P_mismatch + Q_mismatch)

        if np.max(np.abs(mismatch)) < tol:
            return Vm, Va, Pg, Qg, True

        # Build Jacobian numerically
        n_P = len(P_mismatch)
        n_Q = len(Q_mismatch)
        n_state = n_P + n_Q

        if n_state == 0:
            return Vm, Va, Pg, Qg, True

        J = np.zeros((n_state, n_state))
        eps = 1e-8

        for j in range(n_state):
            Va_plus = Va.copy()
            Vm_plus = Vm.copy()

            if j < n_P:
                idx = state_P_idx[j]
                Va_plus[idx] += eps
            else:
                idx = state_Q_idx[j - n_P]
                Vm_plus[idx] += eps

            V_plus = Vm_plus * np.exp(1j * Va_plus)
            S_inj_plus = np.conj(V_plus) * (ybus @ V_plus) * baseMVA

            P_calc_plus = np.real(S_inj_plus) + Pd - np.real(S_gen)
            Q_calc_plus = np.imag(S_inj_plus) + Qd - np.imag(S_gen)

            for i, bus_idx in enumerate(state_P_idx):
                J[i, j] = (P_calc_plus[bus_idx] - P_calc[bus_idx]) / eps
            for i, bus_idx in enumerate(state_Q_idx):
                J[n_P + i, j] = (Q_calc_plus[bus_idx] - Q_calc[bus_idx]) / eps

        try:
            delta = np.linalg.lstsq(J, -mismatch, rcond=None)[0]

            for i, idx in enumerate(state_P_idx):
                Va[idx] += delta[i]
            for i, idx in enumerate(state_Q_idx):
                Vm[idx] += delta[n_P + i]

            Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

            for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
                Vm[i] = np.clip(Vm[i], bus['vmin'], bus['vmax'])

        except:
            return Vm, Va, Pg, Qg, False

    return Vm, Va, Pg, Qg, False

def compute_branch_flows(buses, branches, ybus, Vm, Va, baseMVA):
    """Compute branch power flows"""
    n_buses = len(buses)
    bus_ids = {bus['id']: i for i, bus in enumerate(buses)}

    branch_flows = []

    for branch in branches:
        f = bus_ids[branch['from_bus']]
        t = bus_ids[branch['to_bus']]

        Vf = Vm[f] * np.exp(1j * Va[f])
        Vt = Vm[t] * np.exp(1j * Va[t])

        z = branch['r'] + 1j * branch['x']
        y = 1.0 / z

        tap_ratio = branch['ratio']
        angle = branch['angle']

        if tap_ratio != 0 and tap_ratio != 1.0:
            tap = tap_ratio * np.exp(1j * angle)
            S_from = (y * np.abs(Vf)**2 / np.abs(tap)**2 - y * Vf * np.conj(Vt) / np.conj(tap)) * baseMVA
            S_to = (y * np.abs(Vt)**2 - y * Vt * np.conj(Vf) / tap) * baseMVA
        else:
            S_from = (y * np.abs(Vf)**2 - y * Vf * np.conj(Vt)) * baseMVA
            S_to = (y * np.abs(Vt)**2 - y * Vt * np.conj(Vf)) * baseMVA

        loading = np.abs(S_from) / branch['rateA'] * 100 if branch['rateA'] > 0 else 0

        branch_flows.append({
            'from_bus': branch['from_bus'],
            'to_bus': branch['to_bus'],
            'flow_from_MVA': np.abs(S_from),
            'flow_to_MVA': np.abs(S_to),
            'loading_pct': loading,
            'limit_MVA': branch['rateA'] * baseMVA
        })

    return branch_flows

def main():
    # Load network data
    data = load_network('/root/network.json')

    baseMVA = data['baseMVA']

    # Parse data
    buses = parse_bus_data(data['bus'], baseMVA)
    generators = parse_gen_data(data['gen'], baseMVA)
    gencosts = parse_gencost_data(data['gencost'])
    branches = parse_branch_data(data['branch'], baseMVA)

    print(f"Network: {data['name']}")
    print(f"Base MVA: {baseMVA}")
    print(f"Buses: {len(buses)}, Generators: {len(generators)}, Branches: {len(branches)}")

    # Build Ybus
    ybus = build_ybus(buses, branches)

    # Solve AC OPF
    print("\nSolving AC Optimal Power Flow...")
    Vm, Va, Pg, Qg, status = solve_acopf(buses, generators, gencosts, branches, ybus, baseMVA)

    Va_deg = Va * 180 / np.pi
    Pg_MW = Pg * baseMVA
    Qg_MVAr = Qg * baseMVA

    # Compute branch flows
    branch_flows = compute_branch_flows(buses, branches, ybus, Vm, Va, baseMVA)

    # Compute totals
    total_Pg = np.sum(Pg_MW)
    total_Qg = np.sum(Qg_MVAr)
    total_Pd = sum(bus['Pd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses)
    total_Qd = sum(bus['Qd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses)
    total_losses = total_Pg - total_Pd

    # Verify power balance
    V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
    S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

    Pd_arr = np.array([bus['Pd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses])
    Qd_arr = np.array([bus['Qd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses])

    S_gen = np.zeros(len(buses), dtype=complex)
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
        S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg_MW[k] + 1j * Qg_MVAr[k]

    P_mismatch = np.real(S_inj) + Pd_arr - np.real(S_gen)
    Q_mismatch = np.imag(S_inj) + Qd_arr - np.imag(S_gen)

    max_P_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(P_mismatch))
    max_Q_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(Q_mismatch))

    # Voltage violations
    v_violations = []
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        if Vm[i] < bus['vmin']:
            v_violations.append(bus['vmin'] - Vm[i])
        elif Vm[i] > bus['vmax']:
            v_violations.append(Vm[i] - bus['vmax'])
    max_v_violation = max(v_violations) if v_violations else 0.0

    # Branch overloads
    overloads = []
    for bf in branch_flows:
        if bf['flow_from_MVA'] > bf['limit_MVA']:
            overloads.append(bf['flow_from_MVA'] - bf['limit_MVA'])
    max_overload = max(overloads) if overloads else 0.0

    # Compute cost
    total_cost = 0.0
    for k, cost in enumerate(gencosts):
        PgMW = Pg_MW[k]
        if cost['n'] >= 3:
            c = cost['c']
            total_cost += c[0] * PgMW**2 + c[1] * PgMW + c[2]
        elif cost['n'] == 2:
            c = cost['c']
            total_cost += c[0] * PgMW + c[1]

    # Build report
    report = {
        "summary": {
            "total_cost_per_hour": round(total_cost, 2),
            "total_load_MW": round(total_Pd, 2),
            "total_load_MVAr": round(total_Qd, 2),
            "total_generation_MW": round(total_Pg, 2),
            "total_generation_MVAr": round(total_Qg, 2),
            "total_losses_MW": round(total_losses, 2),
            "solver_status": status
        },
        "generators": [],
        "buses": [],
        "most_loaded_branches": [],
        "feasibility_check": {
            "max_p_mismatch_MW": round(max_P_mismatch, 6),
            "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": round(max_Q_mismatch, 6),
            "max_voltage_violation_pu": round(max_v_violation, 6),
            "max_branch_overload_MVA": round(max_overload, 6)
        }
    }

    # Add generators
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        report["generators"].append({
            "id": gen['id'],
            "bus": gen['bus'],
            "pg_MW": round(Pg_MW[k], 4),
            "qg_MVAr": round(Qg_MVAr[k], 4),
            "pmin_MW": round(gen['Pmin'] * baseMVA, 4),
            "pmax_MW": round(gen['Pmax'] * baseMVA, 4),
            "qmin_MVAr": round(gen['Qmin'] * baseMVA, 4),
            "qmax_MVAr": round(gen['Qmax'] * baseMVA, 4)
        })

    # Add buses
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        report["buses"].append({
            "id": bus['id'],
            "vm_pu": round(Vm[i], 6),
            "va_deg": round(Va_deg[i], 4),
            "vmin_pu": bus['vmin'],
            "vmax_pu": bus['vmax']
        })

    # Sort branches by loading and add top 10 most loaded
    sorted_branches = sorted(branch_flows, key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)[:10]
    for bf in sorted_branches:
        report["most_loaded_branches"].append({
            "from_bus": int(bf['from_bus']),
            "to_bus": int(bf['to_bus']),
            "loading_pct": round(bf['loading_pct'], 2),
            "flow_from_MVA": round(bf['flow_from_MVA'], 4),
            "flow_to_MVA": round(bf['flow_to_MVA'], 4),
            "limit_MVA": round(bf['limit_MVA'], 4)
        })

    # Write report
    with open('/root/report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("AC OPF SOLUTION COMPLETE")
    print("="*60)
    print(f"Total Cost: ${total_cost:,.2f}/hr")
    print(f"Total Generation: {total_Pg:.2f} MW, {total_Qg:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"Total Load: {total_Pd:.2f} MW, {total_Qd:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"Total Losses: {total_losses:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Solver Status: {status}")
    print(f"\nFeasibility:")
    print(f"  Max P mismatch: {max_P_mismatch:.6f} MW")
    print(f"  Max Q mismatch: {max_Q_mismatch:.6f} MVAr")
    print(f"  Max voltage violation: {max_v_violation:.6f} pu")
    print(f"  Max branch overload: {max_overload:.6f} MVA")
    print(f"\nReport saved to /root/report.json")

    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC OPF) Solver
Based on the mathematical model in math-model.md
Minimizes generation cost subject to AC power flow constraints
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix, diags
import cmath

def load_network(filepath):
    """Load network data from JSON file (MATPOWER format)"""
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    return data

def parse_bus_data(bus_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse bus data - format: [id, type, Pd, Qd, Gs, Bs, area, vm, va, baseKV, zone, vmax, vmin]"""
    buses = []
    for row in bus_list:
        bus = {
            'id': int(row[0]),
            'type': int(row[1]),  # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=ref
            'Pd': row[2] / baseMVA,  # Convert to p.u.
            'Qd': row[3] / baseMVA,
            'Gs': row[4] / baseMVA,
            'Bs': row[5] / baseMVA,
            'vm': row[7],
            'va': row[8],
            'vmax': row[11],
            'vmin': row[12]
        }
        buses.append(bus)
    return buses

def parse_gen_data(gen_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse generator data - format: [bus, Pg, Qg, Qmax, Qmin, Vg, mBase, status, Pmax, Pmin, Pc1, Pc2]"""
    generators = []
    for i, row in enumerate(gen_list):
        gen = {
            'id': i + 1,
            'bus': int(row[0]),
            'Pg': row[1] / baseMVA,
            'Qg': row[2] / baseMVA,
            'Qmax': row[3] / baseMVA,
            'Qmin': row[4] / baseMVA,
            'Vg': row[5],
            'Pmax': row[8] / baseMVA,
            'Pmin': row[9] / baseMVA
        }
        generators.append(gen)
    return generators

def parse_gencost_data(gencost_list):
    """Parse generator cost data - format: [model, startup, shutdown, n, c(n-1), ..., c0]"""
    costs = []
    for row in gencost_list:
        model = int(row[0])
        n = int(row[3])
        if model == 2:  # Polynomial
            # Cost coefficients: c2, c1, c0 (or fewer if n < 3)
            c = [float(row[4 + i]) for i in range(n)]
            costs.append({'model': model, 'n': n, 'c': c})
        else:
            costs.append({'model': model, 'n': n, 'c': []})
    return costs

def parse_branch_data(branch_list, baseMVA):
    """Parse branch data - format: [from, to, r, x, b, rateA, rateB, rateC, ratio, angle, status, angmin, angmax]"""
    branches = []
    for i, row in enumerate(branch_list):
        branch = {
            'id': i + 1,
            'from_bus': int(row[0]),
            'to_bus': int(row[1]),
            'r': row[2],
            'x': row[3],
            'b': row[4],
            'rateA': row[5] / baseMVA,  # MVA limit in p.u.
            'rateB': row[6] / baseMVA,
            'rateC': row[7] / baseMVA,
            'ratio': row[8],  # Transformer tap ratio
            'angle': row[9] * np.pi / 180,  # Convert to radians
            'angmin': row[11] * np.pi / 180,
            'angmax': row[12] * np.pi / 180
        }
        branches.append(branch)
    return branches

def build_ybus(buses, branches):
    """Build bus admittance matrix"""
    n_buses = len(buses)
    ybus = np.zeros((n_buses, n_buses), dtype=complex)

    # Create bus index mapping
    bus_ids = {bus['id']: i for i, bus in enumerate(buses)}

    for branch in branches:
        f = bus_ids[branch['from_bus']]
        t = bus_ids[branch['to_bus']]

        r = branch['r']
        x = branch['x']
        z = r + 1j * x
        y = 1.0 / z

        tap_ratio = branch['ratio']
        angle = branch['angle']

        # Series admittance
        y_series = y

        # Shunt admittance
        b = branch['b']
        y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

        # Handle transformer with tap ratio
        if tap_ratio != 0 and tap_ratio != 1.0:
            tap = tap_ratio * np.exp(1j * angle)
            ybus[f, f] += y_series / (tap * np.conj(tap)) + y_shunt
            ybus[t, t] += y_series
            ybus[f, t] -= y_series / np.conj(tap)
            ybus[t, f] -= y_series / tap
        else:
            # Regular line (tap = 1.0)
            ybus[f, f] += y_series + y_shunt
            ybus[t, t] += y_series + y_shunt
            ybus[f, t] -= y_series
            ybus[t, f] -= y_series

    return ybus

def power_flow_equations(x, buses, generators, gencosts, ybus, baseMVA):
    """
    Compute power balance mismatches
    x = [Vm_1, ..., Vm_n, Va_1, ..., Va_n, Pg_1, ..., Pg_ng, Qg_1, ..., Qg_ng]
    """
    n_buses = len(buses)
    n_gens = len(generators)

    # Extract voltages
    Vm = x[:n_buses]
    Va = x[n_buses:2*n_buses]
    Pg = x[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
    Qg = x[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

    # Build voltage vector
    V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)

    # Compute complex power injection
    S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

    # Compute load
    S_load = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        S_load[i] = bus['Pd'] + 1j * bus['Qd']

    # Compute generator injection
    S_gen = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
        S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

    # Power mismatch (excluding reference bus)
    P_mismatch = []
    Q_mismatch = []
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        P_calc = S_inj[i].real + S_load[i].real - S_gen[i].real
        Q_calc = S_inj[i].imag + S_load[i].imag - S_gen[i].imag

        if bus['type'] == 3:  # Reference bus - don't include Q mismatch
            P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
        elif bus['type'] == 2:  # PV bus - don't include Q mismatch
            P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
        else:  # PQ bus
            P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
            Q_mismatch.append(Q_calc)

    return np.array(P_mismatch + Q_mismatch)

def cost_function(x, generators, gencosts):
    """Compute total generation cost"""
    n_buses = len(x) // 2  # Approximation
    n_gens = len(generators)

    Pg = x[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]

    total_cost = 0.0
    for k, (gen, cost) in enumerate(zip(generators, gencosts)):
        Pgpu = Pg[k]
        PgMW = Pgpu * 100.0  # Convert back to MW for cost calc

        # Polynomial cost: c2*Pg^2 + c1*Pg + c0
        if cost['n'] >= 3:
            total_cost += cost['c'][0] * PgMW**2 + cost['c'][1] * PgMW + cost['c'][2]
        elif cost['n'] == 2:
            total_cost += cost['c'][0] * PgMW + cost['c'][1]
        elif cost['n'] == 1:
            total_cost += cost['c'][0]

    return total_cost

def solve_acopf(buses, generators, gencosts, branches, ybus, baseMVA):
    """
    Solve AC Optimal Power Flow using sequential quadratic programming
    """
    n_buses = len(buses)
    n_gens = len(generators)

    # Identify reference bus
    ref_bus_idx = next(i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 3)

    # Initial guess
    Vm_init = np.array([bus['vm'] for bus in buses])
    Va_init = np.array([bus['va'] * np.pi / 180 for bus in buses])
    Pg_init = np.array([gen['Pg'] for gen in generators])
    Qg_init = np.array([gen['Qg'] for gen in generators])

    # Set reference bus angle to 0
    Va_init[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

    # Initial state vector (excluding reference bus angles and Q at PV buses)
    # We'll handle constraints differently

    x0 = np.concatenate([Vm_init, Va_init, Pg_init, Qg_init])

    # Create masks for variable indices
    Va_mask = np.ones(n_buses, dtype=bool)
    Va_mask[ref_bus_idx] = False

    PV_buses = [i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 2]
    PQ_buses = [i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 1]

    # Function to extract variables and compute mismatches
    def mismatch_and_cost(state):
        Vm = state[:n_buses]
        Va = state[n_buses:2*n_buses]
        Pg = state[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
        Qg = state[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

        # Ensure reference angle is 0
        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
        S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

        # Load
        Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
        Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])

        # Generator injection at buses
        S_gen = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
        for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
            bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
            S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

        # Power balance
        P_balance = np.real(S_inj) + Pd - np.real(S_gen)
        Q_balance = np.imag(S_inj) + Qd - np.imag(S_gen)

        # Mismatches for PQ and PV buses (P) and PQ buses (Q)
        mismatch = []

        # P mismatch for all buses except reference
        for i in range(n_buses):
            if i != ref_bus_idx:
                mismatch.append(P_balance[i])

        # Q mismatch for PQ buses only
        for i in PQ_buses:
            mismatch.append(Q_balance[i])

        mismatch = np.array(mismatch)

        # Cost
        cost = 0.0
        for k, cost_data in enumerate(gencosts):
            PgMW = Pg[k] * baseMVA
            if cost_data['n'] >= 3:
                c = cost_data['c']
                cost += c[0] * PgMW**2 + c[1] * PgMW + c[2]
            elif cost_data['n'] == 2:
                c = cost_data['c']
                cost += c[0] * PgMW + c[1]

        return mismatch, cost, S_inj, S_gen, Vm, Va

    # Use Newton-Raphson power flow as starting point, then optimize
    # For simplicity, we'll use the initial power flow solution and adjust dispatch

    def objective_and_constraints(state):
        Vm = state[:n_buses]
        Va = state[n_buses:2*n_buses]
        Pg = state[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
        Qg = state[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0
        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
        S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

        Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
        Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])

        S_gen = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
        for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
            bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
            S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

        # Power balance constraints
        constraints = []

        # P balance for non-reference buses
        for i in range(n_buses):
            if i != ref_bus_idx:
                constraints.append({
                    'type': 'eq',
                    'fun': lambda s, idx=i: np.real(S_inj[idx]) + Pd[idx] - np.real(S_gen[idx])
                })

        # Q balance for PQ buses
        for i in PQ_buses:
            constraints.append({
                'type': 'eq',
                'fun': lambda s, idx=i: np.imag(S_inj[idx]) + Qd[idx] - np.imag(S_gen[idx])
            })

        # Cost
        cost = 0.0
        for k, cost_data in enumerate(gencosts):
            PgMW = Pg[k] * baseMVA
            if cost_data['n'] >= 3:
                c = cost_data['c']
                cost += c[0] * PgMW**2 + c[1] * PgMW + c[2]
            elif cost_data['n'] == 2:
                c = cost_data['c']
                cost += c[0] * PgMW + c[1]

        return cost, constraints

    # Simplified approach: Run power flow first, then economic dispatch
    # For this implementation, we'll use a more practical approach

    # Use scipy's minimize with constraints
    def objective(state):
        Vm = state[:n_buses]
        Va = state[n_buses:2*n_buses]
        Pg = state[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
        Qg = state[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

        cost = 0.0
        for k, cost_data in enumerate(gencosts):
            PgMW = Pg[k] * baseMVA
            if cost_data['n'] >= 3:
                c = cost_data['c']
                cost += c[0] * PgMW**2 + c[1] * PgMW + c[2]
            elif cost_data['n'] == 2:
                c = cost_data['c']
                cost += c[0] * PgMW + c[1]

        return cost

    def eq_constraints(state):
        Vm = state[:n_buses]
        Va = state[n_buses:2*n_buses]
        Pg = state[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
        Qg = state[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0
        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
        S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

        Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
        Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])

        S_gen = np.zeros(n_buses, dtype=complex)
        for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
            bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
            S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

        cons = []

        # P balance for non-reference buses
        for i in range(n_buses):
            if i != ref_bus_idx:
                cons.append(np.real(S_inj[i]) + Pd[i] - np.real(S_gen[i]))

        # Q balance for PQ buses
        for i in PQ_buses:
            cons.append(np.imag(S_inj[i]) + Qd[i] - np.imag(S_gen[i]))

        return np.array(cons)

    # Bounds
    bounds = []

    # Vm bounds
    for bus in buses:
        bounds.append((bus['vmin'], bus['vmax']))

    # Va bounds (exclude reference)
    for i in range(n_buses):
        if i == ref_bus_idx:
            bounds.append((0.0, 0.0))  # Reference angle fixed
        else:
            bounds.append((-np.pi, np.pi))

    # Pg bounds
    for gen in generators:
        bounds.append((gen['Pmin'], gen['Pmax']))

    # Qg bounds
    for gen in generators:
        bounds.append((gen['Qmin'], gen['Qmax']))

    # Constraint definitions for SLSQP
    cons = []

    # P balance constraints
    for i in range(n_buses):
        if i != ref_bus_idx:
            cons.append({'type': 'eq', 'fun': lambda s, idx=i: eq_constraints(s)[idx]})

    # Q balance constraints
    for i, pq_idx in enumerate(PQ_buses):
        offset = n_buses - 1  # Number of P constraints
        cons.append({'type': 'eq', 'fun': lambda s, off=offset, pq=pq_idx: eq_constraints(s)[off + i]})

    try:
        result = minimize(
            objective,
            x0,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=bounds,
            constraints=cons,
            options={'ftol': 1e-9, 'maxiter': 1000, 'disp': False}
        )

        status = 'optimal' if result.success else 'infeasible'

        # Extract solution
        Vm = result.x[:n_buses]
        Va = result.x[n_buses:2*n_buses]
        Pg = result.x[2*n_buses:2*n_buses + n_gens]
        Qg = result.x[2*n_buses + n_gens:]

        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Optimization failed: {e}")
        status = 'infeasible'
        Vm, Va, Pg, Qg = Vm_init, Va_init, Pg_init, Qg_init

    return {
        'Vm': Vm,
        'Va': Va,
        'Pg': Pg,
        'Qg': Qg,
        'status': status,
        'x_opt': result.x if 'result' in dir() else x0
    }

def compute_power_flow_solution(buses, generators, ybus, baseMVA, Vm_init, Va_init):
    """Run power flow to get consistent solution"""
    n_buses = len(buses)

    ref_bus_idx = next(i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 3)

    def power_mismatch(state):
        Vm = state[:n_buses]
        Va = state[n_buses:]
        Va[ref_bus_idx] = 0.0

        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
        S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

        Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] for bus in buses])
        Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] for bus in buses])

        # P mismatch for all buses except reference
        P_mismatch = []
        Q_mismatch = []

        for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
            P_calc = np.real(S_inj[i]) + Pd[i]
            Q_calc = np.imag(S_inj[i]) + Qd[i]

            if i == ref_bus_idx:
                P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
            else:
                P_mismatch.append(P_calc)
                Q_mismatch.append(Q_calc)

        return np.array(P_mismatch + Q_mismatch)

    # Newton-Raphson power flow
    state = np.concatenate([Vm_init, Va_init])

    for _ in range(100):
        mismatch = power_mismatch(state)
        if np.max(np.abs(mismatch)) < 1e-8:
            break

        # Jacobian
        # Simplified - using numerical derivatives
        eps = 1e-8
        J = np.zeros((2*n_buses - 1, 2*n_buses))

        for j in range(2*n_buses):
            state_plus = state.copy()
            state_plus[j] += eps
            mismatch_plus = power_mismatch(state_plus)
            J[:, j] = (mismatch_plus - mismatch) / eps

        # Solve for update
        try:
            delta = np.linalg.lstsq(J, -mismatch, rcond=None)[0]
            state += delta
        except:
            break

    return state

def compute_branch_flows(buses, branches, ybus, Vm, Va, baseMVA):
    """Compute branch power flows"""
    n_buses = len(buses)
    bus_ids = {bus['id']: i for i, bus in enumerate(buses)}

    branch_flows = []

    for branch in branches:
        f = bus_ids[branch['from_bus']]
        t = bus_ids[branch['to_bus']]

        Vf = Vm[f] * np.exp(1j * Va[f])
        Vt = Vm[t] * np.exp(1j * Va[t])

        # Series admittance
        z = branch['r'] + 1j * branch['x']
        y = 1.0 / z

        tap_ratio = branch['ratio']
        angle = branch['angle']

        if tap_ratio != 0 and tap_ratio != 1.0:
            # Transformer
            tap = tap_ratio * np.exp(1j * angle)
            S_from = (y * np.abs(Vf)**2 / np.abs(tap)**2 - y * Vf * np.conj(Vt) / np.conj(tap)) * baseMVA
            S_to = (y * np.abs(Vt)**2 - y * Vt * np.conj(Vf) / tap) * baseMVA
        else:
            # Regular line
            S_from = (y * np.abs(Vf)**2 - y * Vf * np.conj(Vt)) * baseMVA
            S_to = (y * np.abs(Vt)**2 - y * Vt * np.conj(Vf)) * baseMVA

        loading = np.abs(S_from) / branch['rateA'] * 100 if branch['rateA'] > 0 else 0

        branch_flows.append({
            'from_bus': branch['from_bus'],
            'to_bus': branch['to_bus'],
            'flow_from_MVA': np.abs(S_from),
            'flow_to_MVA': np.abs(S_to),
            'loading_pct': loading,
            'limit_MVA': branch['rateA'] * baseMVA
        })

    return branch_flows

def main():
    # Load network data
    data = load_network('/root/network.json')

    baseMVA = data['baseMVA']

    # Parse data
    buses = parse_bus_data(data['bus'], baseMVA)
    generators = parse_gen_data(data['gen'], baseMVA)
    gencosts = parse_gencost_data(data['gencost'])
    branches = parse_branch_data(data['branch'], baseMVA)

    print(f"Network: {data['name']}")
    print(f"Base MVA: {baseMVA}")
    print(f"Buses: {len(buses)}, Generators: {len(generators)}, Branches: {len(branches)}")

    # Build Ybus
    ybus = build_ybus(buses, branches)

    # Solve AC OPF
    print("\nSolving AC Optimal Power Flow...")
    solution = solve_acopf(buses, generators, gencosts, branches, ybus, baseMVA)

    Vm = solution['Vm']
    Va = solution['Va'] * 180 / np.pi  # Convert to degrees
    Pg = solution['Pg'] * baseMVA  # Convert to MW
    Qg = solution['Qg'] * baseMVA  # Convert to MVAr

    # Compute branch flows
    branch_flows = compute_branch_flows(buses, branches, ybus, Vm, solution['Va'], baseMVA)

    # Compute totals
    total_Pg = np.sum(Pg)
    total_Qg = np.sum(Qg)
    total_Pd = sum(bus['Pd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses)
    total_Qd = sum(bus['Qd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses)
    total_losses = total_Pg - total_Pd

    # Compute cost
    total_cost = 0.0
    for k, cost in enumerate(gencosts):
        PgMW = Pg[k]
        if cost['n'] >= 3:
            c = cost['c']
            total_cost += c[0] * PgMW**2 + c[1] * PgMW + c[2]
        elif cost['n'] == 2:
            c = cost['c']
            total_cost += c[0] * PgMW + c[1]

    # Verify feasibility
    # Compute power mismatches
    V = Vm * np.exp(1j * solution['Va'] * np.pi / 180)
    S_inj = np.conj(V) * (ybus @ V) * baseMVA

    Pd = np.array([bus['Pd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses])
    Qd = np.array([bus['Qd'] * baseMVA for bus in buses])

    # Generator injection at buses
    S_gen = np.zeros(len(buses), dtype=complex)
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        bus_idx = next(i for i, b in enumerate(buses) if b['id'] == gen['bus'])
        S_gen[bus_idx] += Pg[k] + 1j * Qg[k]

    P_mismatch = np.real(S_inj) + Pd - np.real(S_gen)
    Q_mismatch = np.imag(S_inj) + Qd - np.imag(S_gen)

    max_P_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(P_mismatch))
    max_Q_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(Q_mismatch))

    # Voltage violations
    v_violations = []
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        if Vm[i] < bus['vmin'] or Vm[i] > bus['vmax']:
            v_violations.append(abs(Vm[i] - bus['vmin']) if Vm[i] < bus['vmin'] else abs(Vm[i] - bus['vmax']))
    max_v_violation = max(v_violations) if v_violations else 0.0

    # Branch overloads
    overloads = []
    for bf in branch_flows:
        if bf['flow_from_MVA'] > bf['limit_MVA']:
            overloads.append(bf['flow_from_MVA'] - bf['limit_MVA'])
    max_overload = max(overloads) if overloads else 0.0

    # Build report
    report = {
        "summary": {
            "total_cost_per_hour": round(total_cost, 2),
            "total_load_MW": round(total_Pd, 2),
            "total_load_MVAr": round(total_Qd, 2),
            "total_generation_MW": round(total_Pg, 2),
            "total_generation_MVAr": round(total_Qg, 2),
            "total_losses_MW": round(total_losses, 2),
            "solver_status": solution['status']
        },
        "generators": [],
        "buses": [],
        "most_loaded_branches": [],
        "feasibility_check": {
            "max_p_mismatch_MW": round(max_P_mismatch, 6),
            "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": round(max_Q_mismatch, 6),
            "max_voltage_violation_pu": round(max_v_violation, 6),
            "max_branch_overload_MVA": round(max_overload, 6)
        }
    }

    # Add generators
    for k, gen in enumerate(generators):
        report["generators"].append({
            "id": gen['id'],
            "bus": gen['bus'],
            "pg_MW": round(Pg[k], 4),
            "qg_MVAr": round(Qg[k], 4),
